1000177.name: NORDIC AMERICAN TANKERS Ltd
1000177.text: Nordic American Tankers specializes in Suezmax tankers, and a significant portion of its earnings is related to the oil industry. Its results depend on tanker charter rates, vessel values, and demand for tanker transportation.

1000184.text: SAP provides business applications covering finance, procurement, HR, supply chain and customer experience, sold mainly as cloud subscriptions. It is headquartered in Walldorf, Germany, with a global presence. Customers include organizations, governments and regulated industries.

1000753.text: Insperity provides human resources and business solutions, including professional employer organization (PEO) services through its HR360, HR360 Select Edition, and HRScale offerings. It serves small and medium-sized businesses in the United States from physical offices in 44 markets.

1001316.text: TG Therapeutics is a commercial-stage biotechnology company focused on acquiring, developing and commercializing treatments for B-cell diseases. The company markets BRIUMVI (ublituximab-xiiy), an FDA-approved monoclonal antibody for relapsing forms of multiple sclerosis, in the U.S. and internationally through a partnership with Neuraxpharm.

1002047.name: NetApp, Inc.
1002047.text: NetApp provides data infrastructure software and storage, centered on its ONTAP software, all-flash and hybrid-flash systems, and cloud-native solutions. It is headquartered in San Jose, California, and supports data across on-premises, hybrid, multi-cloud and edge environments. It serves thousands of enterprises worldwide.

1002242.text: Eni is an Italian joint stock company headquartered in Rome that produces and sells energy products and services in worldwide markets. Its businesses include exploring for and producing crude oil and natural gas, making oil-based fuels and chemicals, gas-fired power, and renewable energy products.

1002590.name: STAR GROUP, L.P.
1002590.text: Star Group is a home heating oil and propane distributor and services provider. It serves residential and commercial customers with heating-related services.

1003935.name: NICE Ltd.
1003935.text: NICE is a global enterprise software company offering AI-powered cloud platforms for Customer Engagement, including its CXone platform, and for Financial Crime and Compliance. CXone helps enterprises automate customer service, while NICE's financial crime solutions help financial institutions prevent money laundering and fraud.

1004315.text: National Grid operates regulated electricity and gas networks in the UK and US, covering transmission and distribution. It also sells gas and electricity to residential and commercial customers.

1005284.name: UNIVERSAL DISPLAY CORP \PA\
1005284.text: Universal Display develops and commercializes OLED technologies and materials for display and solid-state lighting applications. It sells OLED materials and licenses its patents and know-how, with customers primarily large display manufacturers for products such as mobile phones, televisions and monitors.

1009001.name: CAMECO CORP
1009001.text: Cameco files this Form 40-F annual report and lists its principal executive offices in Canada. Its agent for service in the United States is located at the Smith Ranch-Highland Operation in Douglas, Wyoming.

1013237.text: FactSet is a global financial digital platform providing data, analytics, and AI-powered technologies to investment professionals. It operates across Americas, EMEA, and Asia Pacific regions with offices in multiple countries. The company serves institutional asset managers, wealth managers, hedge funds, and other investment professionals.

1015922.text: Check Point Software Technologies develops information and network security solutions for enterprises. The company competes in global cybersecurity markets against companies including Cisco, Fortinet, and Palo Alto Networks.

101984.text: UEI designs, manufactures and licenses home entertainment control products, climate control solutions, smart home sensors and software. It is headquartered in Scottsdale, Arizona and has international subsidiaries in countries including Brazil, Germany, India and China. Its customers include HVAC equipment makers, video service providers, consumer electronics brands, and security and home automation companies, as well as retailers in key markets.

1021561.text: Nu Skin (NUS) develops and distributes beauty and wellness products, including skin care devices, cosmetics and nutritional supplements, along with Rhyz companies. It sells through direct selling to consumers and a sales network of affiliates. About 26% of 2025 revenue came from the United States, with the remainder from international markets.

1022408.name: EPLUS INC
1022408.text: ePlus is a technology solutions provider covering AI, cloud, data center, security, networking and collaboration, through product, professional services and managed services segments. It serves about 4,200 customers, mainly middle-market to large enterprises and state and local government institutions. It sells mainly in the U.S., with sales also in the UK, EU, India and Singapore.

1023313.name: FORRESTER RESEARCH, INC.
1023313.text: Forrester is a global independent research and advisory firm serving business and technology leaders in technology, customer experience, digital, marketing, sales, and product functions. Its offerings include subscription research such as Forrester Decisions, the Forrester AI tool, consulting, and events. It operates through Research, Consulting, and Events segments.

1023459.name: Simulations Plus, Inc.
1023459.text: Simulations Plus is a biopharma-focused provider of modeling and simulation software and consulting services for drug discovery, development, clinical trial operations and commercialization. It is headquartered in Research Triangle Park, NC, with a European office in Paris, France. Its clients include major pharmaceutical, biotechnology, agrochemical, cosmetics and food companies, as well as academic and regulatory agencies worldwide.

1030894.text: Celestica designs and manufactures data center infrastructure, including networking switches, optical systems, racks, servers and storage, and provides supply chain and electronics manufacturing services. It also serves aerospace and defense, industrial, HealthTech and capital equipment markets. Its sites are in North America, Asia and Europe, and its customers include hyperscalers, cloud service providers, OEMs and enterprise customers.

1031203.name: GROUP 1 AUTOMOTIVE INC
1031203.text: Group 1 Automotive operates dealerships that sell and lease new and used vehicles, arrange financing, and sell parts, maintenance, and collision repair services. It operates in 17 U.S. states and in 62 towns and cities in the U.K.

1032208.text: Sempra is a holding company whose main businesses are regulated electric and gas utilities in California and Texas, including SDG&E and SoCalGas. Its Sempra Infrastructure unit has investments in the U.S. and Mexico focused on LNG, energy networks and low carbon solutions. Its utilities provide energy services to customers in Southern California and Texas.

1032220.text: Maximus provides tech-enabled services to government agencies, including health insurance eligibility and enrollment, clinical assessment services and technology solutions. It operates in the United States and worldwide, serving primarily U.S. federal and state government customers.

1032975.text: Logitech designs and sells computer peripherals and software-enabled hardware for work, gaming, and video collaboration. Headquartered in Switzerland, it operates globally, selling through retailers, distributors, and direct channels to businesses and consumers.

1035267.text: ISRG develops and markets robotic-assisted surgical systems, including da Vinci platforms, and diagnostic systems. The company provides instruments, software, and support services to hospitals and healthcare systems worldwide.

1035354.name: Eloxx Pharmaceuticals, Inc.
1035354.text: Eloxx is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company developing small molecule candidates that modulate the ribosome to promote readthrough of premature stop codons caused by nonsense mutations. Its lead candidate, exaluren, is in development for rare kidney diseases such as Alport syndrome, and it collaborates with Almirall on ZKN-013 for rare skin diseases.

103595.name: VILLAGE SUPER MARKET INC
103595.text: Village Super Market operates in the grocery industry and competes with supermarket chains, warehouse clubs, pharmacies, discount and online retailers, and restaurants. It offers the ShopRite Price Plus and Fairway Insider customer loyalty programs. The excerpt does not state where the company operates.

1035983.text: Comfort Systems USA provides mechanical and electrical contracting services through 50 operating units in 142 US cities. Its mechanical division offers HVAC, plumbing and fire protection, while its electrical division handles system installation and servicing. The company serves commercial, industrial and institutional customers in manufacturing, healthcare, education and government sectors.

1037038.name: RALPH LAUREN CORP
1037038.text: Ralph Lauren is a global designer, marketer, and distributor of luxury lifestyle products, including apparel, handbags, footwear and accessories, fragrances, home, and hospitality. It sells through 594 retail stores, 644 concession-based shop-within-shops, digital commerce sites, and about 9,500 wholesale doors, primarily specialty stores, and through licensees. It sells to consumers worldwide, with segments in North America, Europe, and Asia.

1037646.text: Mettler-Toledo is a leading global supplier of precision instruments and services for research, quality control, and manufacturing. Products include laboratory balances, pipettes, analytical instruments, and process analytics solutions for pharmaceutical, biotech, food, and chemical industries. It operates in more than 140 countries.

1038074.text: Silicon Labs designs and manufactures analog-intensive, mixed-signal semiconductors for the Internet of Things (IoT). Its wireless microcontrollers and integrated circuits support Bluetooth, Wi-Fi, Zigbee, and other wireless protocols. The company serves electronics manufacturers and developers globally through direct sales and distributors.

1038683.text: Ryanair Holdings is the holding company for Ryanair DAC, a low-fare scheduled passenger airline serving short-haul, point-to-point routes mainly within Europe. The group flies to approximately 235 airports across Europe. It serves fare-conscious leisure and business travelers.

1040470.text: Aehr Test Systems, headquartered in Fremont, California, provides test, burn-in and stabilization systems for semiconductor devices at wafer and package level. Its applications include AI processors, silicon carbide and gallium nitride power devices, and silicon photonics.

104169.text: Walmart is an omnichannel retailer operating over 10,900 stores across 19 countries and eCommerce platforms. It serves approximately 280 million weekly customers through both physical retail and online channels, offering merchandise and services at everyday low prices.

1041803.name: PRICESMART INC
1041803.text: PriceSmart operates warehouse club stores, with 56 clubs in Central America, the Caribbean and Colombia as of August 31, 2025, and plans to expand into Chile. It serves individual members and business members, including restaurants and institutions that buy products for resale, and offers consumable merchandise, private label goods, and optical and pharmacy services.

1043000.text: Sonida Senior Living (SNDA) owns, operates and invests in senior housing communities, offering independent living, assisted living and memory care, mainly to people aged 75 and older. As of December 31, 2025, it owned, managed or invested in 96 communities in 20 U.S. states.

1045986.name: FORMULA SYSTEMS (1985) LTD
1045986.text: Formula Systems is an Israeli holding company that has primarily acquired controlling interests in companies in the IT solutions and services industry. Its subsidiaries provide services including IT infrastructure and software solutions. Clients named in the excerpt include Bezeq, HOT, Cellcom, YES, Israel Railways, and multiple government bodies.

1046179.text: TSMC (Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company) is a dedicated foundry that manufactures semiconductors from customers' proprietary designs, and also offers design, mask-making, advanced packaging and testing services. It has fabs mainly in Taiwan, plus facilities in the United States, China and Japan. Its customers include fabless chip designers, system companies and integrated device manufacturers.

1047340.text: Fresh Del Monte is a vertically integrated producer, marketer and distributor of fresh and fresh-cut fruit and vegetables, and a producer of prepared foods, juices and snacks in Europe, Africa and the Middle East. It sells under the Del Monte brand in more than 80 countries. Customers include retail, club and convenience stores, wholesalers, distributors and foodservice operators.

1048268.name: IES Holdings, Inc.
1048268.text: IES Holdings designs and installs integrated electrical and technology systems and infrastructure products through four segments: Communications, Residential, Infrastructure Solutions, and Commercial & Industrial. It is headquartered in Sugar Land, Texas. Its end markets include data centers, residential housing, and commercial and industrial facilities.

1049606.text: CompX International manufactures security products, including cabinet locks, and marine components, including wake enhancement systems, exhaust systems and gauges. Its products are used in postal, recreational transportation, furniture, healthcare and marine applications. Its largest customer is the United States Postal Service, which accounted for 26% of 2025 net sales. The excerpt does not state where it operates beyond its North American market and facilities in South Carolina, Illinois and Wisconsin.

1049659.name: NATIONAL STEEL CO
1049659.text: National Steel sells steel products and iron ore and has operations in Brazil. The excerpt refers to the Brazilian domestic market and U.S. markets for its steel products.

1050140.name: DESCARTES SYSTEMS GROUP INC
1050140.text: Descartes is a Canadian company with principal executive offices in Waterloo, Ontario. The excerpt is only the form cover page, so its products and customers are not described.

105016.text: Watsco is the largest HVAC/R distributor in North America, distributing air conditioning, heating, refrigeration equipment, and related supplies. Operating 695 locations across 43 U.S. states, Canada, Mexico, and Puerto Rico, Watsco serves over 130,000 active contractors in the replacement and new construction markets.

1050377.name: PC CONNECTION INC
1050377.text: PC Connection is a Fortune 1000 solutions provider offering IT hardware, software, networking, data center, security, and AI products, plus managed and professional services. It serves corporate, government, educational, and small business customers, and its GlobalServe offering provides procurement coverage in over 150 countries.

1050797.text: Columbia Sportswear designs and markets outdoor, active and lifestyle apparel, footwear, accessories and equipment under the Columbia, Mountain Hardwear, prAna and SOREL brands. It sells products in 115 countries through wholesale customers, including specialty and sporting goods stores, department stores and internet retailers, and through its direct-to-consumer channel.

105132.text: WD-40 (WDFC) develops and sells maintenance products, including WD-40 Multi-Use Product and WD-40 Specialist, and homecare and cleaning products. It sells in more than 176 countries and territories through hardware stores, automotive outlets, industrial distributors, mass retailers, grocers and online retailers.

1051512.text: TDS provides communications services through TDS Telecom, with 1.1 million broadband, video, voice and wireless connections at December 31, 2025. Products include broadband, video, voice and MVNO wireless service. TDS Telecom operates in 30 states, serving residential and small- to mid-sized business customers.

1051627.text: AXTI develops and produces high-performance semiconductor substrates used in fiber optics, 5G infrastructure, and optoelectronic applications. All manufacturing is conducted in China through subsidiaries.

1053706.name: CRA INTERNATIONAL, INC.
1053706.text: CRA International is a global consulting firm providing economic, financial, and management consulting services, including litigation and regulatory support. Founded in 1965, it serves corporate clients, attorneys, law firms, government agencies, utilities, and trade associations, and has completed engagements for clients around the world.

105634.text: EMCOR is a specialty contractor providing electrical and mechanical construction, building, and industrial services through approximately 100 operating subsidiaries, primarily serving commercial, manufacturing, healthcare and government customers in the United States.

1056696.text: Manhattan Associates develops cloud-based supply chain and omnichannel commerce software solutions for retailers, wholesalers, manufacturers, and logistics providers. Headquartered in Atlanta, the company delivers Manhattan Active applications as subscription-based SaaS, enabling customers to manage supply chain execution, inventory, and omnichannel operations globally.

1057379.text: Hackett Group (HCKT) is a generative AI strategic advisory, business transformation and enterprise application implementation firm. It offers AI-enabled platforms built on its benchmarking IP, along with Oracle, SAP, OneStream and eProcurement implementation services. Its Quantum Leap software-as-a-service platform supports clients. The excerpt does not state where it operates or specify its customer base.

1058090.text: Chipotle owns and operates restaurants serving burritos, bowls, quesadillas, tacos and salads with responsibly sourced ingredients. As of December 31, 2025, the company operated 3,938 U.S. restaurants and 104 international locations.

1058290.text: Cognizant is a professional services company providing consulting, application development, systems integration, infrastructure, security, and automation services to clients in healthcare, financial services, manufacturing, retail, aerospace, communications, media, and technology industries.

1059556.text: Moody's is an integrated risk assessment firm providing data, analytics, credit ratings and research through two segments serving financial services, corporate, banking and insurance customers. With approximately 16,000 employees across more than 40 countries, Moody's helps customers navigate global risk and financial complexity.

106040.name: WESTERN DIGITAL CORP
106040.text: Western Digital is a developer, manufacturer and provider of hard disk drive data storage devices and solutions, headquartered in San Jose, California. It serves cloud and enterprise customers, OEM and channel customers for desktop and notebook devices, and consumers through retail and channel partners globally.

1060822.text: Carter's designs and sells apparel and accessories for babies and young children under the Carter's, OshKosh, Little Planet, Otter Avenue and Skip Hop brands. It sells through company-operated retail stores, eCommerce, and wholesale channels, including Walmart, Target and Amazon, and operates in North America and internationally through licensees.

1061574.name: CGI INC
1061574.text: CGI Inc. (GIB) is a Quebec-incorporated company whose annual report on Form 40-F covers the fiscal year ended September 30, 2025. The excerpt provided does not describe its services, operating locations, or customers.

1061736.text: FEMSA (Fomento Económico Mexicano, S.A.B. de C.V.) focuses on its retail businesses, the Coca-Cola FEMSA beverage business and digital solutions such as Spin. It is headquartered in Monterrey, Mexico, and in 2024 acquired 249 convenience stores in Texas, United States. Its retail businesses aim to meet customers' daily needs.

1062579.name: AMDOCS LTD
1062579.text: Amdocs provides software and services to communications, entertainment and media companies in developed countries and emerging markets, serving approximately 400 such service providers. Its customers include large telecommunications companies such as AT&T, Verizon and Vodafone, as well as broadband, mobile and entertainment providers.

1063259.name: DENISON MINES CORP.
1063259.text: Denison Mines is a Canadian company incorporated in Ontario, with principal executive offices in Toronto. The excerpt provided is only the cover page and does not describe its products, operations or customers.

1064728.text: Peabody is a producer of metallurgical and thermal coal, with interests in 16 active coal mines in the U.S. and Australia at December 31, 2025. Its coal supply agreements are primarily with electricity generators, industrial facilities and steel manufacturers.

1066194.text: eGain sells a SaaS platform for AI-driven knowledge management to enterprises. Its platform centralizes enterprise knowledge across customer service, employee support and AI-powered automation. eGain is headquartered in Sunnyvale, California and also operates in the United Kingdom and India. Its solutions are used by large enterprises and government organizations across North America and Europe.

1067491.text: Infosys (INFY) provides AI-first business consulting and technology services to enterprises. Its primary markets are North America, Europe, the Rest of the World and India. Its clients are in industries including financial services and insurance, retail and consumer goods, telecom and media, manufacturing, hi-tech, and life sciences and health care.

1069183.name: AXON ENTERPRISE, INC.
1069183.text: Axon Enterprise (Axon) is a technology company providing integrated hardware and software for public and private sector customers. Its products include TASER energy devices, body and in-car cameras, drones, cloud-based evidence management, and records management software. Axon has headquarters in Scottsdale, Arizona, with hubs across major U.S. cities and expansion in Europe, Asia, and the Americas.

1070081.name: PTC THERAPEUTICS, INC.
1070081.text: PTC Therapeutics is a global biopharmaceutical company that discovers, develops and commercializes medicines for children and adults with rare disorders, focused on neurology and metabolism. Its product Sephience treats phenylketonuria (PKU) and is approved in the EEA, the United States, Japan and Brazil.

1070423.name: PLAINS ALL AMERICAN PIPELINE LP
1070423.text: PAA (Plains All American Pipeline) provides midstream infrastructure and logistics services for crude oil and NGL, including transportation, terminalling, storage, processing and fractionation. It operates in the United States and Canada. Its customers include producers and refiners.

1071321.name: TURKCELL ILETISIM HIZMETLERI A S
1071321.text: Turkcell is a telecommunications operator in Türkiye offering mobile services, including 5G, and fixed-line services such as fiber-to-the-home and fixed wireless access. Through a subsidiary, it operates in data center and cloud infrastructure, including a planned Google Cloud region in Türkiye.

1071438.name: BRASKEM SA
1071438.text: Braskem is a Brazilian petrochemical company and, by plant capacity, the largest plastics producer in the Americas according to CMA. It offers chemicals and plastics, including polypropylene and polyethylene, from integrated operations in Brazil and Mexico, with supply operations in the United States and Europe. Customers in more than 70 countries transform its products into items such as food packaging, automotive components and paints.

1071739.name: CENTENE CORP
1071739.text: Centene is a managed care company focused on underserved populations, offering Medicaid, Medicare, and Marketplace health coverage. It serves Medicaid and Medicare members and individuals and families through the Health Insurance Marketplace. Its membership totaled 27.6 million as of December 31, 2025.

1073404.name: GERDAU S.A.
1073404.text: Gerdau is a steel company with a significant portion of its operations in North America, and it exports steel products from Brazil. The excerpt says its markets depend on consuming sectors such as construction and automotive, but it does not describe its specific products or customers.

1075531.text: Booking operates five online travel and restaurant reservation brands: Booking.com, Priceline, Agoda, KAYAK, and OpenTable. The company facilitates online bookings for accommodations, flights, attractions and restaurants for consumers globally. It serves travelers, travel service providers, restaurants and businesses through merchant, agency and advertising revenue models.

107687.text: Winnebago manufactures towable and motorhome RVs and boats under brands including Winnebago, Grand Design, Chris-Craft and Newmar, plus lithium "house power" batteries. It produces in Indiana, Iowa and Florida and sells RVs and marine products through independent dealers in the U.S. and Canada, who sell to end consumers.

1076930.name: NOVANTA INC
1076930.text: Novanta is a supplier of core technology solutions, including precision components and sub-systems, to medical, life science and advanced industrial original equipment manufacturers (OEMs). It was founded in Massachusetts in 1968 and is now a global company.

1080014.text: Innoviva is a diversified biopharmaceutical company that earns royalties on GSK respiratory products and sells critical care and infectious disease drugs, including GIAPREZA and XACDURO. It also holds strategic healthcare assets, such as a stake in Armata Pharmaceuticals. Headquartered in Burlingame, California.

1082554.text: United Therapeutics develops therapies for serious diseases, particularly pulmonary arterial hypertension. The company markets FDA-approved products including treprostinil formulations and tadalafil in the United States and select international markets. Products are sold through specialty pharmaceutical distributors.

1084765.text: RGP is a global professional services firm offering on-demand talent, consulting and outsourced finance, accounting and HR services. It operates in North America, Europe and Asia Pacific and serves more than 1,500 clients, including CFOs and other C-suite leaders.

1086600.text: Alliance Resource Partners is a diversified natural resource company that mines and sells coal and earns royalties from oil and gas mineral interests. Its coal mines are in Illinois, Indiana, Kentucky, Maryland, Pennsylvania and West Virginia, and its coal is sold mainly to domestic electric utilities, with some industrial and international customers.

1088856.text: Corcept sells Korlym and a generic version in the United States for hypercortisolism (Cushing's syndrome), using sales representatives to call on physicians. It is developing cortisol-modulating drugs, including relacorilant, for hypercortisolism, solid tumors, ALS and MASH.

1089063.text: Dick's Sporting Goods is a sports retailer offering equipment, apparel, footwear and accessories through DICK'S Sporting Goods, Golf Galaxy, Public Lands and Foot Locker banners. The company operates across North America, Europe, Asia and Australia. It serves athletes and sneaker enthusiasts through physical stores and the GameChanger digital platform.

108985.text: York Water (YORW) is a regulated water and wastewater utility supplying water through its own distribution system in York, Adams, Franklin and Lancaster Counties in Pennsylvania. It serves about 81,000 customers in an estimated population of 214,000 within an exclusive franchised territory. Its customers include residential, commercial and industrial users, and it also provides bulk water contracts to municipalities.

1090727.text: UPS is a global package delivery and logistics provider offering transportation, delivery, distribution, contract logistics, ocean freight, airfreight, customs brokerage and insurance. The company serves over 200 countries and territories, with a focus on healthcare, business-to-business, small and medium-sized businesses, and international markets.

1090872.text: Agilent develops and sells instruments, software, services, and consumables for laboratory workflows in life sciences, diagnostics, and applied markets. The company operates globally with R&D and manufacturing in the US, Europe, and Asia-Pacific. It serves pharmaceutical, biopharmaceutical, diagnostic, clinical, and academic customers.

109198.text: TJX is the leading off-price apparel and home fashions retailer with over 5,200 stores. It operates TJ Maxx, Marshalls, and HomeGoods in the U.S., plus TK Maxx in Europe and Australia, serving consumers.

1092699.text: SPS Commerce operates a cloud-based supply chain network and sells products including Fulfillment, Analytics, Assortment and Relationship Management. It connects retailers, brands, distributors, manufacturers and logistics providers, and states it has a presence in Asia Pacific and Europe.

1093557.text: Dexcom designs and commercializes continuous glucose monitoring systems for diabetes and metabolic health management by patients, caregivers, and clinicians worldwide. Its CGM systems enable real-time glucose monitoring with remote monitoring and connectivity to wearable devices such as Apple Watch.

1094517.name: TOYOTA MOTOR CORP/
1094517.text: Toyota designs, manufactures, assembles and sells passenger vehicles, minivans, commercial vehicles and parts, and its financial services business provides financing to dealers and their customers. It sells vehicles in approximately 200 countries and regions, with primary markets in Japan, North America, Europe and Asia.

109563.text: Applied Industrial Technologies is a value-added distributor and technical solutions provider of industrial motion, fluid power, flow control and automation products. The company operates 580 facilities primarily in North America, with additional presence in Australia, New Zealand and Singapore. It serves industrial manufacturers and processors through MRO, OEM and system installation applications.

1097149.text: Align Technology designs and manufactures Invisalign clear aligners, iTero intraoral scanners, and exocad CAD/CAM software for digital dentistry. It sells primarily through dedicated sales force to orthodontists, general dentists, dental laboratories, and dental support organizations globally.

1099590.text: MercadoLibre operates an online marketplace and the Mercado Pago fintech platform, along with logistics, advertising and classifieds services. Its e-commerce platform operates in 18 Latin American countries and its fintech platform in 8, including Argentina, Brazil, Mexico and Chile. It serves buyers, sellers, consumers and merchants.

1099800.text: Edwards Lifesciences develops and markets medical devices for structural heart disease treatment, including transcatheter and surgical valve replacement and repair systems. It operates globally, with commercialization in North America, Europe, and Asia. The company serves cardiac surgeons and interventional cardiologists.

110621.name: RPM INTERNATIONAL INC/DE/
110621.text: RPM is a specialty chemical company whose subsidiaries make paints, coatings, roofing systems, sealants and adhesives for the construction, industrial, specialty and consumer markets. It operates about 120 manufacturing locations in 22 countries and markets products in about 167 countries and territories. Its customers include manufacturers, contractors, distributors, end-users and public institutions.

1107843.text: Qlys provides cloud-based IT, security and compliance solutions delivered through a global platform. It serves over 10,000 customers worldwide, including large organizations and small businesses, through subscription-based software-as-a-service offerings.

1109138.name: CAMTEK LTD
1109138.text: CAMTEK is a semiconductor equipment company whose inspection and metrology systems support the production of AI-related products, including high-bandwidth memory and advanced packaging. It serves integrated device manufacturers, outsourced semiconductor assembly and test providers (OSATs), and foundries. The company sells to customers in a number of countries, including China.

1109345.text: Nova provides metrology tools for process control in semiconductor manufacturing, using optical, X-ray, SIMS and chemical analysis technologies. It is headquartered in Rehovot, Israel, with subsidiaries in the U.S., Taiwan, Korea, China, Japan, Singapore and Germany. Its customers are semiconductor manufacturers in the foundry, memory and packaging sectors.

1110646.text: NetEase develops and operates online games, including over 100 titles, and also offers music streaming, online learning services through Youdao, and Yanxuan private-label consumer products. It conducts its business in China through subsidiaries and VIEs, and some games have launched in North America, Europe and Asia.

1111928.text: IPG Photonics develops, manufactures and sells fiber lasers, fiber amplifiers, diode lasers and laser-based systems for materials processing, medical and advanced applications. It sells globally to original equipment manufacturers, system integrators and end users, and its major manufacturing facilities are in the United States and Germany.

1113809.text: Build-A-Bear is a global retail brand whose stores let guests create personalized plush toys. It offers pre-stuffed plush, gifting and licensed collectible characters through corporate stores, e-commerce, and partner-operated and franchise locations, including internationally. Its customers include children, teens and adults.

1114448.text: Novartis is an innovative medicines company that researches, develops, manufactures and sells pharmaceutical products. Its core therapeutic areas are cardiovascular, renal and metabolic, immunology, neuroscience and oncology. Headquartered in Basel, Switzerland, its products are sold in about 120 countries.

1116132.text: Tapestry operates Coach and kate spade new york, global accessories and lifestyle brands selling handbags, ready-to-wear, jewelry, and footwear. It serves consumers through direct-to-consumer stores, e-commerce, and wholesale channels across North America, Europe, Asia, and other regions.

1116942.name: TTM TECHNOLOGIES INC
1116942.text: TTM Technologies manufactures RF components, mission systems, RF microwave assemblies, PCBs and substrates, with 24 facilities in North America and Asia. It serves about 1,300 customers, including OEMs, EMS providers, ODMs, distributors and government agencies, in aerospace and defense, data center computing, automotive, medical, industrial and networking markets.

1119774.text: Compugen is a clinical-stage company that uses its AI/ML Unigen computational platform to discover and develop cancer immunotherapies. Its principal offices are in Holon, Israel, and it has licensed drug candidates to AstraZeneca and Gilead.

1120914.name: PDF SOLUTIONS INC
1120914.text: PDF Solutions provides data solutions for the semiconductor and electronics ecosystems to improve product yield and quality, delivered through its PDF Solutions Platform. It is headquartered in Santa Clara, California, with offices in the United States, Canada, China, France, Germany, Italy, Japan, South Korea, and Taiwan.

1121788.text: Garmin designs and manufactures GPS-enabled products and services for navigation, communications, and fitness tracking. It serves five primary markets: fitness, outdoor, aviation, marine, and automotive. The company sells to consumers worldwide and commercial customers including aircraft operators and fleet owners.

1122411.text: ASE Technology Holding (ASX) provides semiconductor packaging, testing and related manufacturing services, plus electronics manufacturing services (EMS) through its USI Group. Its main manufacturing facilities are in Taiwan, mainland China, South Korea, Japan, Singapore, Malaysia, the Philippines, Vietnam, Mexico, America, Poland, France, the United Kingdom, Germany, Tunisia, the Czech Republic and Hungary. Its customers are semiconductor companies and EMS customers in computing, communications, industrial and automotive markets.

1123134.text: ChipMOS (IMOS) is one of the leading independent providers of semiconductor assembly and testing services, including for LCD, OLED and automotive display driver chips and for memory and logic/mixed-signal products. Its production facilities are in Hsinchu and Tainan, Taiwan.

1123452.text: ASUR is a Mexican holding company that conducts its operations through subsidiaries, which operate airports in Mexico. It was incorporated in 1998 as part of Mexico's program opening its airports to private investment, and the excerpt refers to passenger traffic at its airports.

1123799.name: WIPRO LTD
1123799.text: Wipro is an AI-powered technology services and consulting company that helps clients with digital transformation, including digital, cloud, engineering, and cybersecurity work. It also offers business process services. The company operates from India and from local offices in North America, Europe, the UK, Australia, Latin America, and Asia.

1124796.name: NLIGHT, INC.
1124796.text: nLIGHT designs, manufactures, and sells high-power semiconductor lasers, fiber lasers, fiber amplifiers, and beam combination and control systems. Its products are sold into Aerospace and Defense, Industrial, and Microfabrication end markets, and are typically integrated into systems or tools built by its customers.

1125376.name: ENSIGN GROUP, INC
1125376.text: Ensign is a holding company whose independent subsidiaries provide skilled nursing, senior living and rehabilitative services, along with mobile diagnostics and medical transportation, in 17 states. It also acquires, leases and owns healthcare real estate. Its services are provided to patients and referral sources in local healthcare communities.

1131399.name: GSK plc
1131399.text: GSK is a biopharmaceutical company focused on respiratory, immunology and inflammation, oncology and HIV medicines, following the 2022 demerger of Haleon. The excerpt describes a truly global reach and a focus on patients.

1133416.name: GALECTIN THERAPEUTICS INC
1133416.text: Galectin Therapeutics (GALT) is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company developing galectin-3 inhibitor drug candidates for fibrotic disease and cancer. Its lead candidate, belapectin, is being studied for MASH with cirrhosis and for preventing esophageal varices.

1137091.name: POWER SOLUTIONS INTERNATIONAL, INC.
1137091.text: Power Solutions International designs, manufactures, and sells emission-certified engines and power systems that run on natural gas, propane, biofuels, gasoline, and diesel. Its products are used primarily by global original equipment manufacturers and end-user customers in power generation, material handling, agricultural, construction, and other applications. The company sells in global markets.

1140625.text: Equinor ASA (EQNR) is a Norway-incorporated energy company headquartered in Stavanger, Norway. It operates in more than 20 countries, with petroleum activities that include oil and gas exploration and production under concession and production sharing regimes.

1140859.text: Cencora is a global pharmaceutical sourcing and distribution company serving healthcare providers in the United States and select global markets. It distributes brand-name, specialty and generic pharmaceuticals, over-the-counter products and home healthcare supplies, plus provides data analytics, consulting and pharmacy automation services. Customers include hospitals, pharmacies, clinics and veterinarians.

1141391.text: Mastercard operates a global payments network enabling electronic transactions for consumers, merchants, and financial institutions through its Mastercard, Maestro, and Cirrus brands. It provides payment products, processing, security, and analytics services supporting consumer, commercial, and digital payments.

1144879.name: Applied Digital Corp.
1144879.text: Applied Digital designs, builds, owns and operates large-scale data centers for high-performance computing and AI workloads, which it leases under long-term arrangements. Its flagship Polaris Forge 1 campus is in Ellendale, North Dakota. Its customers include investment-grade hyperscalers and other compute customers.

1145197.text: Insulet develops, manufactures, and sells continuous insulin delivery systems, primarily the Omnipod platform for people with insulin-dependent diabetes. The company operates in the United States and internationally. It sells through wholesalers, healthcare organizations, and directly to consumers, with coverage through commercial insurance and government healthcare programs.

1156039.text: Elevance Health is a leading U.S. health insurer serving approximately 45.2 million members through managed care plans and health services. Operating in all 50 states and Puerto Rico under brands including Anthem Blue Cross and Wellpoint, the company provides medical, pharmacy and behavioral health coverage. It serves individuals, employer groups, and government program members.

1157408.text: Stride is a technology company that provides an online learning platform for K-12 students throughout the U.S., including full-time virtual schools, and career learning and adult training programs. Its clients are primarily public and private schools, school districts and charter boards, and it also serves employers, government agencies and consumers.

1157557.name: ENERGY CO OF MINAS GERAIS
1157557.text: CEMIG is a state-controlled mixed capital company headquartered in Belo Horizonte, Brazil. It generates, transmits, and distributes electricity, largely through hydroelectric power plants, and distributes natural gas through its subsidiary Gasmig. Its energy distribution business operates in the State of Minas Gerais.

1158114.text: Applied Optoelectronics is a vertically integrated provider of fiber-optic networking and optical communications products for internet data centers, cable television, telecommunications, and fiber-to-the-home markets. The company designs and manufactures components through turn-key equipment with laser chip manufacturing in Sugar Land, Texas, serving hyperscale data center operators, cable providers, and telecommunications equipment manufacturers globally.

1158449.text: Advance Auto Parts is a North American automotive aftermarket parts provider, selling replacement parts, accessories and batteries through stores under the Advance Auto Parts and Carquest names. Its stores are primarily in the U.S., with locations in Canada, Puerto Rico and the U.S. Virgin Islands. It serves professional installers, do-it-yourself customers and independently owned Carquest stores.

1158895.text: LeMaitre Vascular provides vascular medical devices and human tissue cryopreservation services, largely used to treat peripheral vascular disease, end-stage renal disease, and cardiovascular disease. It sells mainly to vascular surgeons and, to a lesser degree, cardiac, general, and neurosurgeons, primarily through direct hospital sales in the United States, Europe, Canada, and Asia Pacific.

1162194.text: Standard BioTools (LAB) provides life science tools, including the CyTOF, Hyperion and Biomark platforms for proteomics and genomics research. It sold its SomaScan business to Illumina, which closed on January 30, 2026. Its instruments and consumables are sold for research use only to academic research institutions, translational research centers, cancer centers, clinical research laboratories, and biopharmaceutical and biotechnology companies.

1163165.text: ConocoPhillips is an independent exploration and production company headquartered in Houston, Texas, with operations in 14 countries. It explores for, produces, transports and markets crude oil, bitumen, natural gas, NGLs and LNG. Its natural gas is sold to local distribution companies, gas and power utilities, large industrials, and oil and gas and marketing companies.

1172358.text: Dorchester Minerals is a Delaware limited partnership that acquires and administers oil and natural gas royalty properties and net profits interests. Its royalty properties are located in 594 counties and parishes in 28 states. Properties operated by ExxonMobil and Chevron are a significant source of its revenue.

1173489.text: Ceva (CEVA) licenses silicon and software IP for connectivity, sensing and edge AI. It has development centers in France, Greece, Ireland, Israel, Serbia and the U.S. Its customers are semiconductor and original equipment manufacturer companies in consumer IoT, automotive, industrial, and mobile and PC markets.

1179929.text: Molina Healthcare provides managed healthcare services to approximately 5.5 million members across 21 states under Medicaid, Medicare, and state marketplace programs. It serves low-income Americans and government-sponsored health plan beneficiaries.

1211583.name: FENNEC PHARMACEUTICALS INC.
1211583.text: Fennec Pharmaceuticals Inc., a British Columbia corporation operating through its Delaware subsidiary, is focused on the commercialization of PEDMARK®.

12208.name: BIO-RAD LABORATORIES, INC.
12208.text: Bio-Rad Laboratories designs, manufactures, and supports diagnostic test systems, reagents, instruments, and software for clinical laboratories in the in vitro diagnostics market. The company also has a Life Science segment. Its customers include university and research institutions, hospital and commercial laboratories, diagnostic manufacturers, and companies in the biotechnology, pharmaceutical, chemical, and food industries.

1231346.name: SEABRIDGE GOLD INC
1231346.text: Seabridge Gold is a Canadian company with principal executive offices in Toronto, Ontario, filing as a foreign private issuer. The excerpt is mainly the cover page and does not describe its products, operating locations or customers.

1237831.text: Globus Medical develops and commercializes medical devices for treating musculoskeletal disorders, including spine surgery solutions and spinal cord stimulation systems. It operates in 65 countries worldwide and serves hospitals, ambulatory surgery centers, and surgeons.

1262039.text: FTNT is a cybersecurity leader offering integrated networking and security solutions. Its platform includes firewalls, SASE, and security operations tools. The company serves enterprises in financial services, retail, healthcare, and government in over 100 countries.

1262823.text: Westlake is a vertically integrated global manufacturer with two segments: Housing and Infrastructure Products (residential siding, trim, windows, PVC pipe and compounds) and Performance and Essential Materials. The company serves residential construction, commercial, industrial and other markets worldwide.

1269238.name: Trip.com Group Ltd
1269238.text: Trip.com is a travel services company offering online and offline booking of transportation tickets, accommodation, and packaged tours. Its corporate travel business provides these services to corporate clients on a service fee basis. It operates 26 customer service centers globally and offline stores with business partners.

1278021.text: MKTX operates electronic trading platforms for fixed-income markets, connecting approximately 2,100 institutional investor and broker-dealer clients globally across 90 countries. Its Open Trading marketplace provides anonymous all-to-all trading and price discovery. MKTX also offers execution solutions, data analytics, and post-trade services.

1278752.name: MidCap Financial Investment Corp
1278752.text: MidCap Financial is a closed-end, externally managed, diversified investment company that has elected to be treated as a business development company (BDC). Its investment adviser is a wholly-owned subsidiary of Apollo Global Management. The excerpt does not state where it operates or describe its customers.

1279495.name: BAYTEX ENERGY CORP.
1279495.text: Baytex has its principal executive offices in Calgary, Alberta, and a U.S. agent for service in Houston, Texas. The excerpt does not describe its operations, products or customers.

1280452.text: Monolithic Power Systems (MPWR) is a fabless global company that designs high-performance, semiconductor-based power electronics solutions, including analog and mixed-signal chips. Its products are used in storage and computing, enterprise data, automotive, industrial, communications and consumer applications.

1280784.name: Hercules Capital, Inc.
1280784.text: Hercules Capital is a specialty finance company and business development company that provides senior secured loans, often structured with equity or warrant rights, to venture capital-backed and institutional-backed companies in technology and life sciences industries.

1282637.text: NewMarket is a holding company whose subsidiaries include Afton (a major lubricant and fuel additives manufacturer with operations in North America, Europe, Asia, Africa and South America), AMPAC (specialty materials for solid rocket motors) and Calca (hydrazine products). AMPAC and Calca serve aerospace and defense markets in the United States.

1285785.name: MOSAIC CO
1285785.text: Mosaic is a producer and marketer of concentrated phosphate and potash crop nutrients and animal feed ingredients. It mines and processes phosphate and potash in Florida, Louisiana, Brazil, Peru, Saskatchewan and New Mexico, and serves customers in approximately 40 countries. Its products are sold to crop nutrient manufacturers, distributors, retailers and farmers.

1286973.name: Americas Gold & Silver Corp
1286973.text: Americas Gold & Silver Corp. is classified as a metal mining company and has its principal executive offices in Toronto, Ontario, Canada. The excerpt is the cover page of its Form 40-F and does not describe its operations, locations or customers.

1287032.name: PROSPECT CAPITAL CORP
1287032.text: Prospect is a financial services company that primarily lends to and invests in middle market privately-held companies, mainly through senior and secured loans. It is a business development company that invests primarily in privately owned U.S. middle market companies.

1287098.text: MaxCyte provides cell engineering platform technology based on its proprietary Flow Electroporation, sold as the ExPERT family of instruments, disposables and consumables. Its customers include biopharmaceutical companies, cell therapy developers, and academic and government research institutions such as the U.S. National Institutes of Health.

1287750.name: ARES CAPITAL CORP
1287750.text: Ares Capital Corporation's excerpt contains only its consolidated financial statements and schedules of investments as of December 31, 2025. It co-invests with Varagon Capital Partners through the Senior Direct Lending Program LLC, in which it owns more than 25% of the voting securities.

1288403.text: W&T Offshore is an independent oil and natural gas producer operating mainly in the Gulf of America. It holds working interests in 49 offshore producing fields in federal and state waters. It sells oil, NGLs and natural gas to third-party customers, with BP Products North America and Shell Trading (US) as its largest purchasers.

1288469.text: MaxLinear is a fabless semiconductor company providing communications systems-on-chip for broadband, mobile and wireline infrastructure, data center, and industrial applications. It serves electronics distributors, OEMs, and ODMs serving data centers, broadband networks, and industrial markets.

1289419.text: Morningstar is a global provider of independent investment insights and data. It offers investment analysis tools, research, credit ratings, and investment management services with approximately $378 billion in assets under management. The company serves asset managers, wealth managers, advisors, and investors globally through desktop and web-based platforms.

1289460.text: Texas Roadhouse operates three casual dining concepts: Texas Roadhouse offering steaks and seafood, Bubba's 33 featuring burgers and pizza, and Jaggers fast-casual restaurants. It operates 714 company-owned and 102 franchised locations across 49 states, one U.S. territory, and ten foreign countries, serving consumers seeking affordable casual dining.

1290109.name: LG Display Co., Ltd.
1290109.text: LG Display is a display panel manufacturer specializing in TFT-LCD and OLED technologies, with panels used mainly in IT products, televisions, mobile devices and automotive displays. Its technology innovation efforts are led from its R&D center in Anyang, Korea.

1290900.name: Commercial Vehicle Group, Inc.
1290900.text: Commercial Vehicle Group is a global provider of systems, assemblies, and components for commercial vehicle and electric vehicle markets, organized into Global Seating, Global Electrical Systems, and Trim Systems and Components segments. It has manufacturing operations in multiple countries, and its products are primarily sold in North America, Europe, and the Asia-Pacific region. Customers include North American commercial truck manufacturers and construction and agriculture OEMs.

1293135.name: VERMILION ENERGY INC.
1293135.text: Vermilion Energy is an Alberta company headquartered in Calgary, filing a Form 40-F annual report for the fiscal year ended December 31, 2025. Its industry classification is crude petroleum and natural gas, but the excerpt does not describe its operations or customers.

1297989.text: EXLS is a global data and AI services company helping enterprises transform through analytics and digital operations. It serves industries including insurance, healthcare, banking, and energy across operations in North America, Europe, Asia, and Africa.

1299130.text: Pacific Biosciences makes genome sequencing systems, including Revio and Vega, along with SMRT Cells, reagents, sequencing workflows and services. Its customers include academic and government research institutions, commercial testing laboratories, hospitals, contract research organizations, pharmaceutical companies and agricultural companies.

1300514.text: Sands owns and operates integrated resort properties featuring premium accommodations, gaming, entertainment, retail, and convention facilities. It operates in Macao and Singapore, serving leisure and business tourists.

1304492.name: Anterix Inc.
1304492.text: Anterix holds licensed 900 MHz spectrum covering the contiguous United States, Hawaii, Alaska, and Puerto Rico. It sells and leases this spectrum and offers TowerX tower access and CatalyX connectivity management, serving utility and critical infrastructure enterprises.

1307954.text: Huntsman is a global manufacturer of organic chemicals in three segments: Polyurethanes, Performance Products and Advanced Materials. Key products include MDI, polyols, TPU, amines and maleic anhydride. It sells mainly to industrial and building product manufacturers. Polyurethane plants are in the U.S., Europe and China.

1313310.name: GRAVITY Co., Ltd.
1313310.text: GRAVITY publishes and distributes mobile and online games based on the Ragnarok Online franchise. The games are launched in markets including Korea, Taiwan, Japan, Europe, the United States, Southeast Asia and China, and serve the company's user base.

1314052.text: Anavex is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company developing treatments for central nervous system diseases, including Alzheimer's disease, Parkinson's disease, schizophrenia and Rett syndrome. Its pipeline includes ANAVEX2-73 (blarcamesine) and ANAVEX3-71.

1317685.name: Alliance Laundry Holdings Inc.
1317685.text: Alliance Laundry designs and manufactures commercial laundry systems and sells them through approximately 600 distributors and, in certain key markets, direct sales channels. It serves markets in North America and other regions around the world. End users include healthcare facilities, fire stations, hotels, laundromats and communal laundry facilities, as well as some residential customers.

1317945.text: Omega Flex (OFLX) manufactures flexible metal hose and related proprietary fittings and accessories. It has facilities in Exton, Pennsylvania, Houston, Texas and Banbury, United Kingdom. It sells mainly through distributors, wholesalers and original equipment manufacturers across North America and Europe, with smaller sales in other global markets. Its products serve construction, medical gas and general industrial markets.

1318008.text: Zumiez (ZUMZ) is a specialty retailer of apparel, footwear, accessories and hardgoods for young men and women, operating through stores and ecommerce under the Zumiez, Blue Tomato and Fast Times names. At January 31, 2026 it operated 719 stores in the United States, Canada, Europe and Australia. It targets customers interested in action sports, streetwear and other lifestyles.

1319161.name: Warner Music Group Corp.
1319161.text: Warner Music Group is a music entertainment company operating the Recorded Music business, with labels such as Atlantic Records, Warner Records and Elektra Records, and the Warner Chappell Music publishing business. It sells music through streaming and other digital platforms, including Apple, YouTube and Tencent Music Entertainment Group.

1321741.name: GLADSTONE INVESTMENT CORPORATION\DE
1321741.text: Gladstone Investment Corporation (GAIN) is an externally managed, closed-end, non-diversified business development company (BDC) that has elected RIC tax treatment. Its common stock and several of its notes trade on the Nasdaq Global Select Market, and its adviser is an affiliate.

1323468.name: GLOBAL PARTNERS LP
1323468.text: Global Partners is a master limited partnership that owns a terminal network and operates gasoline stations and convenience stores, mainly in the Northeast U.S. It purchases, stores, blends and transports refined petroleum products and renewable fuels. It sells home heating oil, gasoline, diesel and other fuels to retail and wholesale distributors, and commercial customers in New England and New York.

1326190.name: Altimmune, Inc.
1326190.text: Altimmune, Inc. is a late clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company developing novel therapies for serious liver diseases. Its lead candidate, pemvidutide, a balanced 1:1 glucagon/GLP-1 dual receptor agonist, is in development for MASH, alcohol use disorder and alcohol-associated liver disease.

1326801.text: Meta develops social media platforms (Facebook, Instagram, WhatsApp, Threads, Messenger) and virtual reality products (Meta Quest, Ray-Ban Meta glasses). It generates revenue primarily through advertising on its apps to reach consumers, and through sales of consumer hardware and content.

1328581.text: Boise Cascade is one of the largest U.S. wholesale distributors of building materials and a manufacturer of engineered wood products and plywood in North America. Its Building Materials Distribution segment runs a nationwide network of distribution facilities. Its customers include dealers, home improvement centers, specialty distributors and industrial accounts.

1329099.name: Baidu, Inc.
1329099.text: Baidu is a Cayman Islands holding company whose operations in Chinese mainland are conducted through subsidiaries and variable interest entities. Those businesses include internet content services, internet map services, online audio and video services, and mobile application distribution. The excerpt does not describe its customers.

1329394.text: Silicon Motion is a semiconductor company that files a Form 20-F. Its trademarks include NANDSustain, Ferri-eMMC and Ferri-UFS. Its US contact address is in Milpitas, California.

1334388.name: OBSIDIAN ENERGY LTD.
1334388.text: Obsidian Energy Ltd. is filing its annual report on Form 40-F for the fiscal year ended December 31, 2025. Its principal executive offices are in Calgary, Alberta, Canada. The excerpt does not describe its products or customers.

1334933.name: URANIUM ENERGY CORP
1334933.text: Uranium Energy Corp is a uranium mining and development company with ISR uranium projects in Wyoming and South Texas and a project in Saskatchewan, Canada. It operates uranium processing plants in Texas and Wyoming. Through its subsidiary, it is pursuing domestic uranium refining and conversion to strengthen the U.S. nuclear fuel supply chain.

1336917.name: Under Armour, Inc.
1336917.text: Under Armour designs, develops, markets and distributes branded performance apparel, footwear and accessories for men, women and youth. It sells through national, regional, independent and specialty retailers and distributors worldwide, and through its direct-to-consumer channel. North America is its largest market.

1336920.text: Leidos provides scientific, engineering and technology services, including digital modernization, mission software, managed health services and energy infrastructure solutions. It operates mainly in the U.S. and serves U.S. government agencies, such as the FAA and VA, plus UK and Australian government agencies and commercial businesses.

1337117.text: Ituran (ITRN) provides stolen vehicle recovery (SVR) services and automatic vehicle location telematics products, plus navigation and fleet management services. It operates in Israel, Brazil, Argentina and other regions. Its customers include retail and commercial subscribers, car manufacturers and insurance companies.

1340677.name: SILVERCORP METALS INC
1340677.text: Silvercorp is a British Columbia company with its principal executive office in Vancouver, filing a Form 40-F annual report for the fiscal year ended March 31, 2026. Its industry classification is gold and silver ores, but the excerpt does not describe its operations or customers.

1342338.name: Himax Technologies, Inc.
1342338.text: Himax is a fabless semiconductor company focused on display imaging processing, including display driver ICs, timing controllers, automotive IC solutions and AI sensing technology. Its products are used in TVs, PC monitors, laptops, mobile phones, tablets, automotive, ePaper and industrial displays. Its operations are conducted through a subsidiary in Taiwan.

1342874.text: Ternium is a steel producer in the Americas that supplies steel products to manufacturing industries and the construction sector. The excerpt names Argentina and Mexico as countries where it works with small and medium-sized customers and suppliers through its ProPymes program.

1345016.text: Yelp (YELP) operates an online platform that connects consumers with local businesses through reviews and other user content. It sells advertising products and subscription services to businesses of all sizes, mainly small and medium-sized businesses, in the United States.

1347557.text: Pacific Airport Group holds concessions to operate twelve airports in Mexico's Pacific and Central regions and two international airports in Jamaica. It earns revenue from fees charged to airlines and passengers, plus rental and commercial income from restaurants, retailers, parking and advertising. Its customers include airlines, airport passengers and commercial tenants.

1349436.text: SandRidge Energy is an independent oil and natural gas company focused on acquisition, development and production in the U.S. Mid-Continent, mainly in Oklahoma, Kansas and Texas. It sells oil, natural gas and NGLs to oil and natural gas companies and energy marketing companies. Three purchasers each accounted for more than 10% of its 2025 revenue.

1352010.text: EPAM is a global provider of digital engineering, cloud and AI-enabled transformation services. It offers software development, product engineering, cloud solutions, data analytics, AI services, customer experience design, marketing, and cybersecurity services. EPAM serves global enterprises and start-ups.

1364479.name: HERC HOLDINGS INC
1364479.text: Herc Holdings is an equipment rental supplier operating 602 locations in North America, offering mid-size, heavy, specialty and contractor equipment for rent. It also sells used equipment and contractor supplies and provides repair, maintenance and equipment management services. Its customers range from individuals and small local contractors to large national accounts.

1369085.name: NEW PACIFIC METALS CORP
1369085.text: New Pacific Metals Corp. has its principal executive offices in Vancouver, British Columbia, Canada, and filed this annual report on Form 40-F for the fiscal year ended June 30, 2026. The excerpt does not describe its business activities, operating locations or customers.

1370053.name: ANAPTYSBIO, INC
1370053.text: AnaptysBio is a clinical-stage biotechnology company developing antibody therapeutics for autoimmune and inflammatory diseases. Its pipeline includes rosnilimab, which completed a Phase 2b trial in moderate-to-severe rheumatoid arthritis, plus ANB033 and ANB101. The company has approved plans to explore separating into two public companies.

1372920.text: New Oriental Education & Technology Group (EDU) runs teaching facilities it calls schools and learning centers. It conducts its business in the PRC through subsidiaries and variable interest entities (VIEs) under contractual arrangements.

1378239.text: Central North Airport Group (GACN) is a Mexican holding company that operates 13 airports in Mexico under 50-year concessions, mainly in the central and northern regions. It charges fees to airlines, passengers and other users, and earns rental and commercial income from activities at its airports. Its airports are located in nine Mexican states.

1379785.name: Barings BDC, Inc.
1379785.text: Barings BDC, Inc. is a closed-end, non-diversified business development company regulated under the Investment Company Act of 1940 and taxed as a regulated investment company. It is headquartered in Charlotte, North Carolina, and its portfolio is managed by Barings LLC as investment adviser. The company was formerly named Triangle Capital Corporation.

1383312.name: BROADRIDGE FINANCIAL SOLUTIONS, INC.
1383312.text: Broadridge is a financial technology company that provides proxy distribution and voting, fund communication, and corporate governance solutions. Its clients include banks, broker-dealers, asset and wealth managers, public companies, investors, and mutual funds. Its international solutions serve EMEA and APAC regions, and its fund communication business serves the UK and European markets.

1383414.name: PENNANTPARK INVESTMENT CORP
1383414.text: PennantPark is a business development company that invests in the debt and equity of U.S. middle-market companies, defined as those with annual revenues between $50 million and $1 billion. Its investments include first lien and second lien secured debt, subordinated debt, and equity. It invests primarily in U.S. companies and, to a limited extent, in non-U.S. companies.

1385849.text: Energy Fuels produces uranium and vanadium and makes rare earth and titanium/zirconium (HMS) products, and is evaluating medical radioisotopes. It operates in the U.S., including its White Mesa Mill in Utah, and in Brazil and Madagascar. Its uranium concentrate is sold to customers for processing into nuclear reactor fuel.

1393052.text: Veeva provides cloud software, data, and business consulting solutions for the global life sciences industry, helping pharmaceutical, biotechnology, and medical device companies develop and commercialize products more efficiently.

1396440.name: Main Street Capital CORP
1396440.text: Main Street Capital is an internally managed business development company that provides debt and equity financing to lower middle market companies, mainly based in the U.S. It also provides debt to private loan companies owned by private equity funds, supporting buyouts, recapitalizations, growth financings and acquisitions.

1397187.text: Lululemon designs, distributes, and retails technical athletic apparel, footwear, and accessories. It operates in 30 countries through an omni-channel model with physical retail locations and e-commerce. The company serves individual customers and wholesale partners including fitness studios, athletic organizations, and corporate entities.

1398659.text: G is an agentic and advanced technology solutions company with 146,500 employees serving clients across 35+ countries. It provides AI and data solutions, business process services, technology services, and digital operations. G serves leading enterprises in financial services, insurance, and other industries.

1403161.text: Visa provides payment transaction processing services including authorization, clearing and settlement across more than 200 countries and territories, serving nearly 14,500 financial institutions, merchants, consumers, and government entities.

1403568.text: Ulta is a specialty beauty retailer offering cosmetics, fragrance, skincare, wellness products, haircare, and salon services through stores and digital platforms. It operates in the U.S., U.K., Ireland, Mexico, and the Middle East, serving beauty enthusiasts.

1408710.name: Fabrinet
1408710.text: Fabrinet (FN) provides advanced optical packaging and precision optical, electro-mechanical and electronics manufacturing services. Its products include optical communications components and modules, industrial lasers, automotive components, medical devices and sensors. Its customers are original equipment manufacturers (OEMs) in optical communications, automotive, industrial lasers, medical and sensor industries.

1418076.name: SLR Investment Corp.
1418076.text: SLR Investment Corp. (SLRC) is an externally managed business development company (BDC) that invests primarily in senior secured loans and financing leases to privately held U.S. middle-market companies. It originates investments mainly through portfolio companies or their financial sponsors and may also invest in foreign markets, including emerging markets.

1420720.text: iBio is a clinical-stage biotechnology company using AI to develop antibodies for obesity, cardiometabolic and cardiopulmonary diseases. Its lead candidate, IBIO-600, is in a Phase 1 trial in Australia, and its research laboratory is in San Diego.

1421876.text: Lakefront Biotherapeutics (LKFT), formerly Galapagos NV, is a Belgium-incorporated biotechnology company developing oncology and immunology drug candidates, including the GLPG3667 TYK2 inhibitor and CAR-T cell therapies. It is headquartered in Mechelen, Belgium, and its cell therapy sites are being wound down. The excerpt does not state its customers.

1422142.text: Whitehawk is a clinical-stage oncology therapeutics company developing three antibody drug conjugates (ADCs) licensed from WuXi Biologics, which use a Hangzhou DAC TOP1 inhibitor linker-payload. It divested its former FYARRO business to KAKEN in March 2025.

1422183.name: FS KKR Capital Corp
1422183.text: FS KKR Capital Corp. is an externally managed business development company that focuses primarily on debt investments in private U.S. companies, including middle-market companies with EBITDA of $50 million to $150 million at the time of investment. Its investment adviser is FS/KKR Advisor, LLC.

1422930.name: PubMatic, Inc.
1422930.text: PubMatic, Inc. is an AI-powered advertising technology company whose platform connects buyers, publishers, data providers, and commerce media networks. It serves publishers, which monetize their advertising inventory, and buyers, including advertisers, agencies, agency trading desks, and demand side platforms.

1425292.name: CVR PARTNERS, LP
1425292.text: CVR Partners produces nitrogen fertilizer, principally urea ammonium nitrate (UAN) and ammonia, at facilities in Coffeyville, Kansas and East Dubuque, Illinois. It sells its products on a wholesale basis in the United States. Its products are used by farmers to improve the yield and quality of crops, primarily corn and wheat.

1429260.name: Fortress Biotech, Inc.
1429260.text: Fortress Biotech is a biopharmaceutical company that acquires and advances pharmaceutical assets through partner and subsidiary companies. Its subsidiary Cyprium's ZYCUBO was FDA-approved in January 2026 for pediatric patients with Menkes disease.

1431852.name: Osisko Gold Group Inc.
1431852.text: Osisko's principal executive offices are in Montréal, Québec, according to its annual report cover page. The excerpt does not describe its operations, locations or customers.

1437107.name: Warner Bros. Discovery, Inc.
1437107.text: Warner Bros. Discovery is a global media and entertainment company that creates and distributes television, film, streaming, gaming, publishing and themed-experience content through brands including HBO Max, CNN and Warner Bros. Motion Picture Group. It serves distributors such as cable, satellite and telecom providers, direct-to-consumer subscribers and advertisers.

1437424.text: POET Technologies is a design and development company offering photonic integrated packaging based on its Optical Interposer, used in optical engines and light source products for AI data-center connectivity. It is incorporated in Ontario, Canada, with operations in California, Singapore, China and Malaysia. Its customers include makers of pluggable optical transceiver modules.

1441816.text: MongoDB is a developer data platform company offering a modern, document-based database designed for unstructured data, along with integrated services for search, analytics, and data processing. It serves development teams and organizations building applications across diverse industries and use cases.

1459200.text: Alarm.com (ALRM) provides a cloud-based IoT platform for connected properties, offering security, video, energy management, access control and related solutions. It sells mainly through service provider partners who serve residential and commercial property owners. Its solutions are used in residential, multi-family, small business and enterprise commercial markets.

1463101.name: Enphase Energy, Inc.
1463101.text: Enphase Energy is a global energy technology company that designs and sells microinverters, batteries and home energy management systems for solar generation, storage and EV charging. Its products are sold through installer and distributor partners. Its systems have been deployed in over 160 countries, serving homeowners and business users.

1464591.name: GeoPark Ltd
1464591.text: GeoPark is an independent energy company with assets in Colombia and Argentina. It produces mainly oil from the Llanos Basin in Colombia and is developing unconventional resources in the Vaca Muerta formation in Argentina's Neuquén Basin. Its principal executive office is in Bogotá, Colombia, and it also produces in Brazil and Ecuador.

1466258.text: Trane Technologies plc is an Ireland-incorporated company that designs, manufactures, sells and services HVAC systems, transport refrigeration and custom refrigeration solutions under the Trane and Thermo King brands. It sells products in approximately 100 countries, and its solutions serve buildings, homes and transportation.

1467373.text: ACN is a global professional services company. It helps enterprises build digital capabilities through strategy, consulting, technology, and operations services. The company operates across Americas, EMEA, and Asia Pacific serving major enterprises worldwide.

1468091.text: VEON is a digital operator providing mobile and fixed telecommunications, digital and cloud services through local brands such as Kyivstar, Banglalink, Toffee and Jazz. It operates in Bangladesh, Kazakhstan, Pakistan, Ukraine and Uzbekistan, and is headquartered in Dubai. It serves consumers and businesses, including through business-to-business OTT services.

14693.name: BROWN FORMAN CORP
14693.text: Brown-Forman manufactures, distills, imports and sells beverage alcohol products, including Jack Daniel's and Old Forester, along with other spirits and ready-to-drink cocktails. It sells products in over 170 countries. In the United States, it sells to distributors or to state governments that sell to retail customers and consumers.

14707.text: Caleres is a global footwear company that designs, sources, and distributes footwear and operates retail shoe stores and e-commerce websites, including Famous Footwear. Its Company-owned stores are located in the US, Canada and East and Southeast Asia. Wholesale customers include online retailers, national chains, department stores, independent retailers and mass merchandisers.

1473334.text: XMax, formerly Nova LifeStyle, is a U.S.-headquartered designer and distributor of contemporary residential and commercial furniture. It markets products through wholesale and retail channels and online platforms worldwide. Its customers are designers, distributors and retailers serving mid-level and high-end private label home furnishings. In March 2026 its board approved a strategic expansion into artificial intelligence.

1476765.name: GOLUB CAPITAL BDC, Inc.
1476765.text: Golub Capital BDC is an externally managed business development company that invests mainly in one stop and senior secured loans to U.S. middle-market companies. Many of these companies are sponsored by private equity firms.

1477641.name: DAQO NEW ENERGY CORP.
1477641.text: Daqo New Energy manufactures and sells polysilicon through its Chongqing Daqo subsidiary in China, and has expanded into wafer manufacturing. It sells polysilicon to China-based photovoltaic product manufacturers, including operating entities of major silicon wafer producers and vertically integrated solar manufacturers.

1479615.name: Silence Therapeutics plc
1479615.text: Silence Therapeutics is a biotechnology company developing siRNA molecules that silence disease-associated genes, using its mRNAi GOLD platform to target genes in the liver. Its lead candidate, divesiran, is in Phase 2 development for polycythemia vera, a rare myeloproliferative neoplasm. Its pipeline also includes zerlasiran, aimed at patients with high Lp(a).

1481513.name: JinkoSolar Holding Co., Ltd.
1481513.text: JinkoSolar makes solar products, including silicon wafers, solar cells and solar modules, and has expanded into energy storage. It has over 10 production facilities globally and sales teams across many countries. Its customers include utility-scale developers, EPC contractors and distributed generation customers.

1483994.name: H World Group Ltd
1483994.text: H World Group is a multi-brand hotel group operating over 20 hotel brands, with 12,858 hotels in operation as of December 31, 2025, under leased and owned, franchised and manachised models. It has international operations and serves members of its H Rewards loyalty program, which had more than 311 million members.

1486159.text: Chord Energy is an independent oil and gas exploration and production company operating primarily in the Williston Basin. It produces crude oil, natural gas, and NGL from approximately 1.3 million net leasehold acres with average daily production of 276,620 net Boepd.

1488917.text: Electromed (ELMD) develops, manufactures, markets and sells the SmartVest Airway Clearance System for patients with compromised pulmonary function. It sells direct to patients and through clinician referrals, and also in acute care settings such as post-surgical and intensive care units.

1489393.text: LYB is a global chemical company that converts hydrocarbon feedstocks into plastic resins and other chemicals, and develops and licenses polyolefin technologies.
