Its products serve manufacturers of food packaging, automotive components, and coatings. The company operates globally with no single customer accounting for 10% or more of revenues.

1494259.name: CarGurus, Inc.
1494259.text: CarGurus is a multinational automotive platform that helps consumers and dealers buy and sell vehicles, with a U.S. marketplace for dealer listings. It also provides dealers with software and data solutions for inventory, pricing, marketing and sales. Its customers are car shoppers and dealers.

1495153.name: MakeMyTrip Ltd
1495153.text: MakeMyTrip is a travel technology platform offering air tickets, hotels, holiday packages, bus and car ground transport, and foreign exchange services. It operates principally in India, and its redBus business also operates in Colombia, Peru, Singapore and Malaysia. It serves Indian customers who research and book travel online.

1496099.name: New Mountain Finance Corp
1496099.text: New Mountain Finance Corp (NMFC) is a closed-end, non-diversified business development company (BDC) with RIC tax treatment. At December 31, 2025, it held 113 portfolio companies, invested mostly in first lien loans, with top industry concentrations in software, business services, healthcare, and consumer services.

1499620.name: TAL Education Group
1499620.text: TAL Education Group is a smart learning solutions provider in China, offering learning services and learning content solutions. Its branch offices are located in 45 Chinese cities, and it has entered overseas markets. It serves learners, teachers and learning institutions.

1504619.name: PennantPark Floating Rate Capital Ltd.
1504619.text: PennantPark Floating Rate Capital (PFLT) is an externally managed business development company (BDC) that invests primarily in floating rate loans to U.S. middle-market companies, defined as those with annual revenues between $50 million and $1 billion. It makes investments to U.S. and, to a limited extent, non-U.S. corporations.

1508655.name: Sixth Street Specialty Lending, Inc.
1508655.text: Sixth Street Specialty Lending is a business development company that generates current income by originating senior secured loans, and to a lesser extent mezzanine and unsecured loans, mainly to U.S.-domiciled middle-market companies. Its portfolio companies are middle-market businesses with EBITDA of $10 million to $250 million.

1509470.name: Neostellar Capital Corp.
1509470.text: SuRo Capital Corp. is an internally managed, non-diversified closed-end investment company that has elected to be regulated as a business development company. It invests mainly in equity securities of venture capital-backed emerging companies, across themes such as AI infrastructure, software-as-a-service and financial technology. The excerpt does not state where it operates or who its customers are.

1511737.text: Ubiquiti develops and sells networking equipment and software platforms for high-capacity internet access and unified network management, distributing products globally through over 100 distributors to service providers, enterprises and customers across more than 200 countries and territories.

1513363.name: FIDUS INVESTMENT Corp
1513363.text: Fidus is an externally managed business development company that provides customized debt and equity financing to lower middle-market companies, defined as U.S.-based companies with revenues between $10.0 million and $150.0 million. It invests across industries including business services, industrial products, healthcare, and aerospace and defense manufacturing. The excerpt does not state where it operates.

1517413.text: Fastly (FSLY) provides an edge cloud platform covering content delivery, application security, API protection and programmable edge computing, sold as infrastructure as a service. The excerpt does not state where it operates beyond a global footprint. It serves organizations across ecommerce, streaming media, gaming, digital publishing, high tech and financial services.

1521036.text: Lnth is a radiopharmaceutical company producing diagnostic and oncology products for clinical use. It markets products throughout the United States and internationally through direct and third-party distribution to hospitals, imaging centers and government facilities.

1521332.text: Aptiv is a global industrial technology company developing advanced automotive and industrial technology solutions across three segments: software and sensors, interconnect systems, and power distribution. The company operates 139 manufacturing facilities across 50 countries. It serves the 25 largest automotive OEMs worldwide, as well as aerospace, defense, and telecom companies.

1526243.name: PERPETUA RESOURCES CORP.
1526243.text: Perpetua Resources is a mining company focused on the Stibnite Gold Project in Idaho, USA, which contains gold, silver and antimony deposits. It is redeveloping several deposits and reprocessing historical tailings on the project. Its head office is in Boise, Idaho.

1527636.name: Autohome Inc.
1527636.text: Autohome operates online platforms autohome.com.cn, che168.com, and ttpai.cn that deliver content and tools to automobile consumers in China and provide services to automakers and dealers across the auto value chain. The company is headquartered in Beijing. Its customers include automobile consumers, automakers, and dealers.

1527753.text: Personalis (PSNL) develops and sells cancer genomic testing services, including its NeXT Personal Dx residual disease test. Its tests are used by physicians, pharmaceutical and biopharmaceutical companies, and diagnostics companies. It performs testing in a CLIA-certified laboratory in Fremont, California, and sells mainly in the United States, Europe and Asia-Pacific.

1528356.name: Genie Energy Ltd.
1528356.text: Genie Energy Ltd. is an energy services provider whose Genie Retail Energy segment supplies electricity and natural gas to residential and small business customers through retail energy providers. Its retail operations span nineteen U.S. states and Washington, D.C., with most customers in the Eastern and Midwestern U.S. and Texas.

1528849.name: RH
1528849.text: RH is a retailer and luxury lifestyle brand in home furnishings, offering furniture, lighting, textiles, bathware, décor, outdoor and garden, and baby, child and teen furnishings. It operates retail locations in the United States, Canada, and Europe.

1529192.name: Vipshop Holdings Ltd
1529192.text: This excerpt from Vipshop's annual report does not describe its products, operations, or customers. It states that the company reports in Renminbi and translates amounts to U.S. dollars at RMB6.9931 to US$1.00, the December 31, 2025 rate.

1530238.text: JOYY is a global technology company that operates social entertainment apps such as Bigo Live, Likee, Hago and imo, and B2B businesses BIGO Ads (programmatic advertising) and Shopline (smart commerce SaaS). It has users and operations in over 150 countries, and its B2B customers are advertisers and merchants.

1531152.text: BJ's Wholesale Club is a membership warehouse operator offering groceries, general merchandise, gasoline, and ancillary services. Operating 263 clubs and 199 gas stations across 21 U.S. states as of fiscal 2025, primarily in the eastern United States, BJ's serves over 8 million individual and business members.

1533232.name: Brookfield Renewable Partners L.P.
1533232.text: Brookfield Renewable owns renewable power assets, with about 47,200 MW of operating capacity, and sustainable solutions investments, including a stake in Westinghouse, a nuclear services business. It invests directly and with institutional and joint venture partners, and holds assets in the Caribbean and Latin America.

1534254.name: CION Investment Corp
1534254.text: CION Investment Corporation is an externally managed, closed-end investment company that has elected to be regulated as a business development company. It invests in portfolio companies, with a focus on U.S. middle-market companies.

1535778.name: MSC INCOME FUND, INC.
1535778.text: MSC Income Fund, Inc. (MSIF) is an externally managed business development company (BDC) that provides debt capital to private companies owned by or being acquired by private equity funds, mainly through secured debt investments. The companies it lends to are generally headquartered in the U.S., and it partners with private equity fund sponsors.

1544206.name: Carlyle Secured Lending, Inc.
1544206.text: Carlyle Secured Lending is an externally managed business development company that makes secured loans, mainly first and second lien senior loans, to U.S. middle market companies with EBITDA of about $25 million or more, often controlled by private equity firms. Headquartered in New York, New York, it is regulated under the Investment Company Act of 1940.

1549346.text: Shutterstock is a creative platform that licenses digital content, including images, footage, music and 3D models, contributed by its network to customers. It also offers metadata licensing, GIPHY distribution and advertising services, and Shutterstock Studios custom content production. Customers include brands and businesses, and metadata customers range from large technology and media companies to start-ups.

1551306.text: Progyny provides fertility, pregnancy and postpartum, and other women's health and family building benefits, plus the Progyny Rx pharmacy solution. It serves more than 590 employers. Its national provider network serves members in virtually every U.S. state.

1552000.text: MPLX is a master limited partnership that owns and operates midstream energy infrastructure, including crude oil and refined product pipelines, terminals, and natural gas and NGL gathering and processing, and provides fuels distribution services. Its assets are positioned throughout the United States. Its largest customer is its sponsor MPC, and it also serves producers in several U.S. shale resource plays.

1552198.name: WhiteHorse Finance, Inc.
1552198.text: WhiteHorse Finance is an externally managed business development company that makes senior secured loans as a direct lender. It targets privately held lower middle market companies located in the United States, defined as those with enterprise values between $50 million and $350 million. As of December 31, 2025, its portfolio had a fair value of about $578.6 million across 68 companies.

1555280.text: Zoetis is a global leader in animal health, discovering and commercializing medicines, vaccines, diagnostics, and genetic tests. Products serve eight species across companion animals (dogs, cats, horses) and livestock, sold through veterinarians and distributors worldwide. Customers include veterinarians, pet owners, and livestock producers.

1557860.text: Globant (GLOB) is a global technology services company that supports organizations' digital transformation through AI services, software engineering and experience design, among other offerings. It has a presence in 31 countries. Its clients are organizations seeking digital transformation support.

1560385.name: Liberty Media Corp
1560385.text: Liberty Media is primarily engaged in the motorsport and live entertainment industries through subsidiaries including Delta Topco (parent of Formula 1) and MotoGP. Its operations are primarily headquartered in the United Kingdom and Spain, with events held worldwide. Formula 1 grants race promoters rights to host and stage Formula 1 Events.

1564708.name: NEWS CORP
1564708.text: News Corp (NWSA) is a global media and information services company offering news, data, digital real estate services, and book publishing under brands such as The Wall Street Journal, Dow Jones, HarperCollins and Realtor.com. It operates primarily in the U.S., Australia and the U.K., with content distributed worldwide. Its customers include individual consumers and enterprise customers.

1565025.text: Ambev manufactures and distributes beverages in Brazil and other countries. Products are packaged in aluminum cans and PET bottles and include ingredients such as malt, hops, and sugar. The company sells to clients throughout the region.

1567094.name: CNH Industrial N.V.
1567094.text: CNH Industrial develops, manufactures and sells agricultural and construction equipment, and its Financial Services segment offers retail and wholesale financing. Its global network includes subsidiaries in 32 countries and a commercial presence in about 166 countries. It serves end customers and dealers.

1567683.name: Clearway Energy, Inc.
1567683.text: Clearway Energy, Inc. is a publicly traded energy infrastructure investor that owns clean energy generation assets across North America. Its portfolio of about 12.9 GW gross capacity in 27 states includes wind, solar and battery energy storage systems, plus combustion-based power generation. Most of its revenue comes from long-term contracts for the output or capacity of these assets.

1567900.text: Blackboxstocks is a financial technology and social media platform offering real-time analytics, news and educational materials to stock and options traders. It is delivered as a subscription SaaS product through web and iOS and Android apps, with members in over 40 countries. The company is also developing products for financial professionals and institutions.

1572694.name: Goldman Sachs BDC, Inc.
1572694.text: Goldman Sachs BDC, Inc. is a specialty finance company that lends to middle-market companies through first lien, unitranche and second lien loans, mezzanine and other unsecured debt, and select equity investments. It is a business development company regulated under the Investment Company Act of 1940.

1573221.name: TheRealReal, Inc.
1573221.text: TheRealReal operates an online marketplace for authenticated, primarily pre-owned luxury goods, including women's fashion, men's fashion, jewelry and watches. It serves consignors and buyers, and it also operates neighborhood retail stores and flagship stores in San Francisco, Los Angeles and New York.

1575515.name: Sprouts Farmers Market, Inc.
1575515.text: Sprouts Farmers Market operates a specialty grocery chain known for fresh produce and natural, organic and better-for-you products. As of December 28, 2025, it had 477 stores in 24 states and was headquartered in Phoenix. Its target customers are 'health enthusiasts' and 'selective shoppers.'

1576280.text: Guardant Health provides precision oncology diagnostics through blood and tissue tests for cancer screening, recurrence monitoring, and treatment selection across all stages of care. The company also collaborates with biopharmaceutical companies for clinical research and drug development.

1577552.text: Alibaba is a Cayman Islands holding company that operates through subsidiaries and variable interest entities. It runs e-commerce platforms such as Taobao, Tmall and Taobao Instant Commerce, international retail and wholesale platforms, and AI and cloud services. Its principal offices are in Hangzhou, China. It serves consumers, merchants, brands, retailers, enterprises and global buyers.

1579241.text: Allegion develops and markets security and access control products including door controls, electronic locks, access control systems and related software. The company operates globally across North America, Europe, Asia and Oceania. It serves commercial, institutional and residential customers including education, healthcare, government, hospitality and retail sectors.

1580905.text: IBP is one of the largest insulation installers in the U.S., operating 250 branches across 48 states. It serves residential and commercial builders with insulation, waterproofing, garage doors, and complementary building products.

1581760.name: Life360, Inc.
1581760.text: Life360 operates a mobile app that helps families stay connected and safe through location sharing, driving safety, digital safety and emergency assistance features. It also sells Tile and Life360 Pet GPS tracking devices and earns revenue from subscriptions, advertising and aggregated data.

1581990.name: PLAINS GP HOLDINGS LP
1581990.text: Plains GP reports on PAA, whose principal business is providing midstream infrastructure and logistics services for crude oil and NGL through transportation, terminalling, storage, processing and fractionation assets. It operates in the United States and Canada and serves producers, refiners and other customers.

1583708.text: SentinelOne develops and commercializes the Singularity Platform, an AI-powered cybersecurity solution for autonomous defense against cyberattacks. The platform protects endpoints, cloud workloads, and identities using distributed AI models and threat analytics. It serves organizations of all sizes globally, including large enterprises, managed security providers, and incident response partners.

1585521.text: Zoom is a collaboration platform offering workplace communication and productivity tools including meetings, chat, phone, and contact center services, integrated with AI capabilities. It serves businesses of all sizes for employee collaboration and customer engagement.

1590364.text: FTAI Aviation is an independent engine maintenance platform focused on CFM56-5B, CFM56-7B and V2500 aircraft engines, which it repairs, rebuilds, sells or leases. It also owns and manages on- and off-lease aircraft and engines through its Aviation Leasing segment and an asset management initiative. It sells and leases engines to airlines and asset owners around the world.

1590955.text: Paycom is a leading cloud-based HCM solution provider offering SaaS software for payroll, talent management, HR, and time and labor management. It serves approximately 39,200 business clients in the United States through its internally developed single-platform system.

1591588.name: Gold.com, Inc.
1591588.text: Gold.com is a fully integrated precious metals company offering bullion, numismatic coins and related products through wholesale, direct-to-consumer and secured lending segments. Its operations span Canada, Europe and Asia, with a focus on Hong Kong and Singapore, and it operates a Las Vegas depository. Customers include banks, coin dealers, collectors, refiners, mints and retail customers.

1591698.text: Paylocity provides cloud-based human capital management, finance, and IT software solutions to U.S. organizations. The unified SaaS platform automates HR processes, payroll, benefits management, and employee workflows. It serves approximately 44,400 clients averaging over 150 employees each through direct sales and a referral network.

1592560.name: VisionSys AI Inc
1592560.text: VisionSys AI is a Cayman Islands holding company, formerly known as Tarena International, with operations through subsidiaries in the United States, Hong Kong and mainland China. The excerpt does not describe its current products or customers. It reported no revenue from continuing operations in 2023 and 2024.

1595761.name: WEIBO Corp
1595761.text: Weibo operates a social media platform that allows users in China and global Chinese communities to share content publicly. It offers advertising and marketing solutions to brands, with users including individuals, celebrities, media outlets, businesses, government agencies, and charities. Its headquarters and principal operations are in Beijing, China.

1596532.text: Arista provides networking-as-a-service solutions and platforms for data centers and AI operations. Its switches, software and services enable Cloud and AI providers, specialty providers and enterprises to reliably access and process data globally.

1598655.name: GasLog Partners LP
1598655.text: GasLog Partners LP (GLOP) is a Marshall Islands limited partnership engaged in owning, operating and acquiring LNG carriers for LNG transportation, with a fleet of 11 vessels as of March 12, 2026. Its ships are provided under time charters.

1600620.name: Aurinia Pharmaceuticals Inc.
1600620.text: Aurinia is a biopharmaceutical company developing therapies for autoimmune diseases. Its product LUPKYNIS (voclosporin) treats adult patients with active lupus nephritis, and it is sold in the United States and, through partner Otsuka, in Japan, the EU, the UK, and Switzerland.

1601046.text: Keysight Technologies provides design and test solutions including hardware, software and services to support product development and commercialization. It serves over 100 countries across industries including communications, aerospace, defense, automotive and semiconductor. The company generated $5.4 billion in revenue in 2025, primarily from R&D applications.

1603454.name: Celcuity Inc.
1603454.text: Celcuity is a clinical-stage biotechnology company developing targeted therapies for the treatment of multiple solid tumors. Its lead product candidate, gedatolisib, is in clinical trials, including a Phase 3 trial for hormone receptor-positive, HER2-negative advanced breast cancer.

16040.name: CABOT CORP
16040.text: Cabot Corporation is a global specialty chemicals and performance materials company headquartered in Boston, Massachusetts. Its principal products include reinforcing and specialty carbons, specialty compounds, carbon nanotubes, fumed metal oxides and aerogel. It has manufacturing facilities and operations in the U.S. and over 20 other countries, and its reinforcing carbons are used in tires and industrial products.

1604481.name: CMB.TECH NV
1604481.text: CMB.TECH NV is a Belgian public limited company headquartered in Antwerp. It operates a maritime group of about 250 seagoing vessels, including dry bulk carriers, crude oil tankers, chemical tankers, container transport and offshore energy vessels. It also offers hydrogen and ammonia fuel to its customers, produced by itself or sourced from third-party producers.

1604665.name: Westlake Chemical Partners LP
1604665.text: Westlake Chemical Partners LP owns a 22.8% limited partner interest in OpCo, which operates three ethylene production facilities that convert ethane into ethylene, plus a 200-mile ethylene pipeline. All of its assets are located and operated in the United States. OpCo sells most of its ethylene to Westlake and sells its co-products to external customers.

1604821.text: Natera is a diagnostics company using proprietary cell-free DNA technology to develop blood-based tests in oncology, women's health and organ health. Based in Austin, Texas with facilities in California and Colorado, the company has a US direct sales force and over 100 international laboratory and distribution partners. It processed 3.5 million tests in 2025.

1606909.text: Pangaea Logistics Solutions provides seaborne drybulk logistics and transportation services, plus terminal and stevedoring services. It transports grains, coal, iron ore, bauxite, cement clinker and other bulk cargoes across more than 300 ports worldwide. It serves industrial customers that ship drybulk cargo.

1610250.name: Boot Barn Holdings, Inc.
1610250.text: Boot Barn is a lifestyle retail chain selling western and work footwear, apparel, and accessories through 539 stores in 49 states and an e-commerce platform. Its customers include western and country enthusiasts as well as workers seeking durable footwear and apparel.

1610601.name: Hello Group Inc.
1610601.text: Hello Group (MOMO) files its annual report in U.S. dollars, translating Renminbi amounts at RMB6.9931 to US$1.00 as of December 31, 2025. The excerpt does not describe its products, services, operating locations or customers.

1612720.name: NextDecade Corp
1612720.text: NextDecade is a Houston-based energy company developing and constructing the Rio Grande LNG Facility, a natural gas liquefaction and export project near Brownsville, Texas. The facility is under construction in phases, with Trains 1 through 5 underway. It has long-term LNG sale and purchase agreements with 14 counterparties.

1621434.name: Black Stone Minerals, L.P.
1621434.text: Black Stone Minerals, L.P. reports oil and natural gas proved reserves, with estimates as of December 31, 2025, 2024 and 2023 independently evaluated by Netherland, Sewell & Associates, Inc.

1622536.text: TLN is an independent power producer operating approximately 13.1 GW of U.S. generation capacity, including 2.2 GW of nuclear power. The company sells electricity, capacity and ancillary services to wholesale power markets in the Mid-Atlantic, Ohio and Montana, including AWS.

1633917.text: PayPal operates a digital payments platform connecting consumers and merchants across approximately 200 markets. It provides digital wallets (PayPal and Venmo), point-of-sale solutions, buy-now-pay-later services, and international money transfers. As of December 2025, the platform had 439 million active accounts.

1635282.text: Rimini Street provides third-party enterprise software support, managed services and ERP innovation solutions, including support for Oracle, SAP and VMware. It markets its services globally through subsidiaries in many countries and serves over 3,100 active clients, including companies, educational institutions and government institutions.

1637715.name: OnKure Therapeutics, Inc.
1637715.text: OnKure Therapeutics is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company developing small-molecule precision medicines. Its lead candidate, OKI-219, selectively inhibits mutated PI3Kα (H1047R) and is in a Phase 1 trial for patients with advanced breast cancer.

1638290.name: MasterCraft Boat Holdings, Inc.
1638290.text: MasterCraft designs, manufactures and markets recreational powerboats under five brands: MasterCraft, Crest, Balise, Chaparral and Robalo. Its boats are sold through a dealer network to consumers.

1639300.text: OLLI operates 645 off-price retail stores selling brand name household products at discounts up to 70% off traditional retailers. It serves value-conscious consumers in 34 states through a treasure hunt shopping environment.

1639877.text: Ferroglobe produces silicon metal, silicon-based alloys and manganese-based alloys, and also mines quartz and low-ash metallurgical coal. It has production centers in North America, Europe, South America, Africa and Asia. Its customers are a diverse base across industries including aluminum, chemicals, automotive parts, solar, semiconductors and electric vehicle batteries.

1641398.name: GD Culture Group Ltd
1641398.text: GD Culture Group sold its China-based VIE subsidiaries in 2023, including Highlight Media, an integrated marketing service agency. In September 2025, it acquired Pallas Capital Holding, which holds digital assets as a long-term reserve and held 7,500 Bitcoin as of December 31, 2025. The company states it no longer has a VIE structure.

1644378.name: RMR GROUP INC.
1644378.text: The RMR Group Inc. (RMR) is a holding company whose subsidiary, RMR LLC, provides management services to publicly traded REITs and private capital vehicles, with $39.0 billion of assets under management as of September 30, 2025. Managed REIT DHC owns properties in 34 U.S. states and the District of Columbia.

1646188.name: Ondas Inc.
1646188.text: Ondas Inc. is a defense, security and critical infrastructure technology company operating through three business units. It develops autonomous systems, such as the Optimus aerial platform and Iron Drone Raider counter-drone platforms, and private wireless networking technologies, such as FullMAX. It serves governments and industrial customers, including defense organizations, security agencies, public safety organizations, airports, ports and energy and industrial markets.

1649744.text: Duluth Trading is a lifestyle brand of men's and women's workwear, casual wear, outdoor apparel and accessories. It sells primarily through its own omnichannel platform, including a website that serves customers nationwide, and as of February 1, 2026 operated 63 retail stores and three outlet stores.

1650729.text: SiteOne Landscape Supply is a wholesale distributor of landscape supplies, including irrigation, hardscapes, fertilizer and control products, nursery goods and outdoor lighting. It operates over 670 branches in 45 U.S. states and five Canadian provinces. Its customers are primarily residential and commercial landscape professionals and contractors.

1652044.text: Alphabet operates Google, a technology company providing search, video (YouTube), email, cloud infrastructure and services, and AI products. Google Cloud serves enterprise customers seeking cloud computing and AI capabilities. Google also generates advertising revenue from advertisers reaching consumers through its platforms.

1653384.name: Runway Growth Finance Corp.
1653384.text: Runway is an externally managed business development company that provides senior secured loans to high growth-potential companies. It focuses on technology, healthcare, business services, financial services, select consumer services and products, and other high-growth industries. Its offices are in Chicago, Menlo Park, and New York.

1653477.name: Ingevity Corp
1653477.text: Ingevity develops and manufactures largely renewably sourced products used in automotive gasoline vapor emissions control, food, water and chemical filtration, asphalt paving, agrochemical dispersants, bioplastics, coatings, elastomers, and road-marking paint. Its principal executive offices are in North Charleston, South Carolina.

1654126.name: ZIM Integrated Shipping Services Ltd.
1654126.text: ZIM is a global container liner shipping company with a fleet of 128 vessels as of December 31, 2025, and it serves ports in Europe, including North Europe and the Mediterranean, and Central America. It serves freight customers, and its 10 largest represented about 12% of 2025 freight revenues.

1655050.name: Bain Capital Specialty Finance, Inc.
1655050.text: Bain Capital Specialty Finance, Inc. (BCSF) is an externally managed, closed-end, non-diversified business development company (BDC) that has elected regulated investment company (RIC) tax treatment. It is managed by an SEC-registered investment adviser, and its common stock trades on the New York Stock Exchange.

1655759.text: Arvinas is a clinical-stage biotechnology company developing therapeutics based on its PROTAC protein degradation platform. Its pipeline targets oncology and neurology indications, including Parkinson's disease and breast cancer. It has early-stage collaborations with Pfizer and Genentech/Roche. The excerpt does not describe its customers or where it operates.

1656081.name: Endava plc
1656081.text: Endava plc (DAVA) is a provider of next-generation technology services that helps clients with digital transformation, including core system transformation and production-grade AI projects. Its headquarters are in London, United Kingdom, and the excerpt does not describe its customer base beyond clients across all industries and regions.

1657788.name: Kimbell Royalty Partners, LP
1657788.text: Kimbell Royalty Partners is a Delaware limited partnership formed in 2015 that owns mineral and royalty interests in oil and natural gas properties throughout the United States. It receives royalties from operators on production from those properties, net of post-production expenses and taxes.

1658566.text: PR is a crude petroleum and natural gas producer that sells its production to a relatively small number of customers, typical in the industry. The excerpt provides limited detail on specific operations and customer identities.

1664710.name: Keros Therapeutics, Inc.
1664710.text: Keros is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company developing protein therapeutics for disorders linked to TGF-ß family signaling. Its lead candidate, rinvatercept, is being developed for neuromuscular diseases, including Duchenne muscular dystrophy and ALS. Its elritercept candidate, licensed to Takeda outside mainland China, Hong Kong, and Macau, is being developed for low blood cell counts in myelodysplastic syndromes and myelofibrosis.

1667011.text: Arteris provides semiconductor system IP, including network-on-chip interconnect IP and SoC integration automation software, which help chip designers move data across chiplet and SoC designs. Its customers are semiconductor companies, system companies and OEMs, serving markets such as automotive, communications and enterprise computing.

1668397.text: MEDP is a leading clinical contract research organization providing Phase I-IV clinical development services to biotechnology, pharmaceutical and medical device companies. It operates from facilities in Cincinnati, Belgium, Shanghai and Singapore, serving small, mid-sized and large pharmaceutical customers.

1669779.name: Camping World Holdings, Inc.
1669779.text: Camping World is America's largest retailer of RVs and related products and services, operating under the Camping World and Good Sam brands. Good Sam offers services and plans such as roadside assistance, protection plans and insurance. As of December 31, 2025, it operated 196 locations, mainly in the United States, and served approximately 4.2 million Active Customers.

1670592.text: YETI, headquartered in Austin, Texas, designs, retails and distributes outdoor products, including coolers, drinkware, bags and apparel. It sells in the United States, Canada, Australia, New Zealand, the United Kingdom, Europe and Japan through direct-to-consumer channels and wholesale retailers such as Dick's Sporting Goods and REI.

1671927.name: Immunocore Holdings plc
1671927.text: Immunocore is a commercial-stage biotechnology company developing immunomodulating medicines using its ImmTAX platform. Its lead product, KIMMTRAK, is approved for unresectable or metastatic uveal melanoma and has been launched in 30 countries, including the United States, Germany and France.

1671933.text: TTD is a global advertising technology platform empowering ad buyers to create, manage and optimize digital advertising campaigns across formats, channels and devices. TTD's AI-driven platform integrates inventory, publisher and data partners. Clients include advertising agencies, advertisers, and service providers.

1673358.text: Yum China operates KFC, Pizza Hut, Lavazza, Huang Ji Huang, Little Sheep and Taco Bell restaurants in China. The company operates over 18,100 units across more than 2,500 cities primarily in mainland China. It serves consumers seeking quick-service and casual dining options.

1673743.name: Hinge Health, Inc.
1673743.text: Hinge provides AI-powered care for joint and muscle (MSK) health, using AI motion tracking, a nerve stimulation wearable, and a care team of licensed physical therapists, physicians, and health coaches. Its core clients are self-insured employers, including public-sector employers such as state and local governments and labor unions, and it also serves health plans' fully-insured and Medicare Advantage populations and federal insurance plans.

1677250.name: ZTO Express (Cayman) Inc.
1677250.text: ZTO Express (ZTO) operates express parcel delivery services in China through its consolidated affiliated entity ZTO Express, using a network of partners for pickup and delivery. Its senders include merchants on e-commerce platforms and enterprise customers.

1677576.name: INNOVATIVE INDUSTRIAL PROPERTIES INC
1677576.text: Innovative Industrial Properties is an internally managed REIT that owns specialized industrial and commercial properties in the United States, 111 of them across 19 states as of December 31, 2025. Its properties are primarily leased to state-licensed operators of regulated cannabis facilities. It also holds financial investments in the life science industry.

1683695.text: Intermex provides money remittance services, mainly from the United States to Latin America and the Caribbean. It operates through over 100,000 sending and paying agents, 118 company-operated stores and digital channels. Its customers are consumers sending money, many without a traditional full-service financial institution relationship.

1690511.name: Canada Goose Holdings Inc.
1690511.text: Canada Goose designs, manufactures, markets and distributes lifestyle outerwear, apparel, footwear and accessories. Headquartered in Toronto, it produces most of its goods in Canada and sells in Japan through its CG Japan joint venture. Its Baffin footwear is sold through distributors and retailers in Canada and the United States.

1693256.name: Select Water Solutions, Inc.
1693256.text: Select Water Solutions provides water-management solutions to the U.S. energy industry through water infrastructure, water services and chemical technologies. Its infrastructure includes pipelines, recycling and treatment facilities, storage and saltwater disposal wells, with its largest ongoing investments in the Permian Basin. It serves energy industry customers under long-term contracts for produced water management.

1697862.text: argenx (ARGX) is a Dutch biopharmaceutical company with its official seat in Amsterdam. Its main medicine, VYVGART, treats generalized myasthenia gravis, CIDP and ITP, and it treats patients globally. Its customers include patients, physicians and payers.

1699031.text: GRAL develops Galleri, a multi-cancer early detection test from a blood draw that screens for multiple cancer types and identifies the tissue of origin. Through partnerships, GRAL serves healthcare systems, employers, digital health platforms, payors, and life insurance providers.

1699136.name: Cactus, Inc.
1699136.text: Cactus designs, manufactures, sells and rents highly engineered pressure control and spoolable pipe technologies, used principally for onshore unconventional oil and gas wells. It operates service centers and pipe yards in the United States, Canada and Australia, plus rental and service operations in the Middle East and other select international markets.

1701541.text: Black Diamond Therapeutics is a clinical-stage oncology company developing MasterKey therapies that target families of oncogenic mutations in cancer. Its lead candidate, silevertinib, is in a Phase 2 trial in patients with EGFR-mutant non-small cell lung cancer.

1701758.text: Lovesac designs, manufactures and sells modular furniture, including Sactionals modular couches, Sacs beanbag chairs, and StealthTech sound systems. It sells direct to consumers through 278 showrooms in 45 U.S. states and online at lovesac.com.

1703647.text: Korro Bio is a biopharmaceutical company developing RNA-editing oligonucleotide medicines that aim to make precise, transient changes to RNA rather than DNA. Its lead program, KRRO-121, is in preclinical development for urea cycle disorders.

1704715.text: Alpha is a Tennessee-based miner producing mainly metallurgical coal, with some thermal coal as a byproduct, from mines in Virginia and West Virginia. It sells met coal to domestic and international steel and coke producers, and thermal coal to utilities and industrial customers.

1709164.name: Hamilton Beach Brands Holding Co
1709164.text: Hamilton Beach designs, markets and distributes small electric housewares appliances, commercial products for restaurants, fast-food chains, bars and hotels, and connected healthcare devices and software. Consumer products are sold mainly in North America to retailers, distributors and end consumers, and health devices are leased to specialty pharmacy networks and pharmaceutical companies.

1709941.text: BioAge Labs (BIOA) is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company developing treatments for metabolic diseases by targeting human aging biology. Its lead program, BGE-102, is an oral NLRP3 inhibitor being studied for cardiometabolic disease and diabetic macular edema. The excerpt does not state where it operates or its customers.

1711375.name: Loma Negra Compania Industrial Argentina Sociedad Anonima
1711375.text: Loma Negra produces and distributes cement, masonry cement, aggregates, concrete and lime, based in Buenos Aires, Argentina, with nationwide operations. It sells primarily to wholesale distributors, concrete producers and industrial customers, and serves private and public construction.

1712807.name: PagSeguro Digital Ltd.
1712807.text: PagSeguro provides payment acceptance and digital banking services in Brazil, operating as an acquirer, card issuer and digital bank. It serves over 34 million clients, including individual entrepreneurs, micro-merchants, small businesses and medium-sized companies, and has over 6.3 million active merchants.

1713748.name: Skeena Resources Ltd
1713748.text: Skeena Resources Limited is a Canadian registrant with principal executive offices in Vancouver, British Columbia. The excerpt is a Form 40-F cover page and does not describe the company's products, operations or customers. It reported 121,300,287 common shares outstanding as of December 31, 2025.

1717115.name: Tempus AI, Inc.
1717115.text: Tempus AI is a healthcare technology company that provides Intelligent Diagnostics, using AI to connect laboratory test results to patients' clinical data through its Tempus Platform. Its customers include physicians, pharmaceutical and biotechnology companies, and researchers. It is one of the largest sequencers of cancer patients in the United States.

1717161.name: CENTRAL PUERTO S.A.
1717161.text: Central Puerto is an Argentine electricity company with thermal, solar, and hydroelectric generation. It is developing battery energy storage projects and a solar plant in Salta, Argentina. Its contracts include power supply to large electric power consumers, and Edenor and Edesur are named as offtakers for its storage projects.

1718405.name: HYCROFT MINING HOLDING CORP
1718405.text: Hycroft Mining is a U.S.-based gold and silver exploration stage company that owns the Hycroft Mine in Northern Nevada. Mining and processing operations were discontinued, and the company generated no revenues in 2025 or 2024. It does not expect revenue from gold and silver sales until mining operations restart.

1722606.name: Metalla Royalty & Streaming Ltd.
1722606.text: Metalla is a Canadian company with its principal executive offices in Vancouver, British Columbia. It holds gold and silver streams and royalty interests in mining operations. The excerpt does not describe its customers.

1725255.name: AdaptHealth Corp.
1725255.text: AdaptHealth is a provider of home medical equipment, medical supplies, and related services across its Sleep Health, Respiratory Health, Diabetes Health, and Wellness at Home segments. It serves patients in all 50 states through about 640 locations in 48 states and services Medicare, Medicaid, and commercial insurance payors.

1727263.text: FTDR is the leading U.S. provider of home warranties protecting against breakdowns of home systems and appliances. It operates five brands and serves approximately 2.1 million homeowner customers through annual service plans and new home builder warranty products.

1728190.name: HUYA Inc.
1728190.text: HUYA operates a game live streaming platform, launched in 2014, that users access through mobile apps, a website and PC clients. Viewers and broadcasters use the platform, and HUYA conducts its business mainly in mainland China.

1729149.text: Viemed provides home medical equipment and post-acute healthcare services, focused on respiratory, chronic care and women's health, including home ventilation, oxygen therapy and sleep apnea treatment. It serves patients in all 50 states of the United States and also provides healthcare staffing services to third-party healthcare facilities.

1729173.text: Uxin (UXIN) operates an online and in-store used car transaction platform in China through its subsidiaries. Its operations are governed by PRC laws, and it has Hong Kong operations. The excerpt does not state who its customers are beyond referring to consumers and businesses.

1736035.name: Blackstone Secured Lending Fund
1736035.text: Blackstone Secured Lending Fund (BXSL) is an externally managed business development company that seeks current income, mainly by investing at least 80% of its total assets in secured debt, primarily first lien senior secured and unitranche loans. It is regulated under the Investment Company Act of 1940 and is advised by Blackstone affiliates.

1736541.name: NIO Inc.
1736541.text: NIO is a smart electric vehicle company that designs, develops, manufactures, and sells smart electric vehicles under the NIO, ONVO, and FIREFLY brands. It sells lifestyle products such as clothing, home goods, electronics, and food through online stores within its apps to its users. Its principal executive offices are in Shanghai, with research and development centers in Shanghai, Anhui, Beijing, San Jose, Munich, and Oxford.

1737287.text: Allogene Therapeutics is a clinical-stage immuno-oncology company developing allogeneic, off-the-shelf engineered T cell product candidates for cancer and autoimmune diseases. Its lead candidates target lymphoma, autoimmune disease and renal cell carcinoma. The excerpt does not describe its customers or where it operates.

1737450.name: Opera Ltd
1737450.text: Opera is a consumer internet software company offering PC and mobile web browsers, gaming portals, news content, an ads platform, and AI and web3 products. It is headquartered in Oslo, Norway, and serves a global base of consumer users.

1737806.text: PDD operates the Pinduoduo and Temu online platforms, where third-party merchants sell products to consumers, and earns revenue from transaction services and online marketing. Its China operations are conducted through contractual arrangements with a variable interest entity. Temu serves consumers in the United States, Japan, Germany, the United Kingdom, France, Canada and Italy.

1738021.name: Compass Therapeutics, Inc.
1738021.text: Compass Therapeutics, Inc. (CMPX) is a clinical-stage oncology biopharmaceutical company developing proprietary antibody-based therapeutics, led by tovecimig, a bispecific antibody targeting DLL4 and VEGF-A. It is evaluating tovecimig in a Phase 2/3 trial in the United States for biliary tract cancer. The excerpt does not describe its customers.

1738699.name: WISeQey Corp.
1738699.text: WISeKey is a Swiss company headquartered in Zug that provides authentication and cybersecurity technology for secure digital identification and communication. Its five verticals are SEALSQ semiconductors, WISeSat satellite communications, SEALCOIN, WISeID trust services and WISe.ART, a secure NFT platform serving the arts and luxury industry.

1742692.text: InMode Ltd. is an Israel-incorporated maker of energy-based medical treatment systems for face and body contouring, medical aesthetics and women's wellness. It sells mainly to plastic and facial surgeons, aesthetic surgeons, dermatologists and OB/GYNs, through a direct sales force and distributors in over 101 countries.

1742770.name: Viomi Technology Co., Ltd
1742770.text: Viomi Technology is a Cayman Islands holding company that conducts its operations in China through WFOEs and VIEs, including internet information and e-commerce services. Xiaomi is its strategic partner and most important customer, and a significant portion of its revenue comes from sales to Xiaomi.

1743340.name: Token Cat Ltd
1743340.text: Token Cat Ltd is based in and has significant operations in China. Its risk factors refer to the auto electronics resale market, and in 2025 all revenue from its continuing operations came from five customers, four of which accounted for about 97.5% of total revenue.

1744676.name: Tencent Music Entertainment Group
1744676.text: Tencent Music is an online music entertainment company in China, operating QQ Music, Kugou, Kuwo, WeSing, and Lazy Audio. Its services include music streaming, live streaming, online karaoke, and audiobooks, podcasts, and other audio content. It operates in the PRC.

1745431.name: StoneCo Ltd.
1745431.text: StoneCo is a provider of payments, banking and credit solutions for merchants. Its main operational hub is in São Paulo, Brazil, and it serves Brazilian merchants, with a focus on micro, small and medium-sized businesses (MSMBs).

1746473.text: Pliant Therapeutics is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company developing integrin-based therapeutics. Its lead candidate, PLN-101095, is an oral small molecule in development for solid tumors resistant to immune checkpoint inhibitors.

1746618.name: Revolve Group, Inc.
1746618.text: Revolve is an online fashion retailer focused on Millennial and Generation Z consumers, offering apparel, footwear, beauty and accessories from over 1,600 brands, including 28 owned brands. It sells through a digital platform and influencer-driven marketing. The excerpt does not state where it operates.

1747172.name: Kayne Anderson BDC, Inc.
1747172.text: Kayne Anderson BDC, Inc. is an externally managed business development company that invests primarily in first lien senior secured loans, with a secondary focus on unitranche and split-lien loans. It lends to private middle market companies, which it defines as companies generating between $10 million and $150 million of annual EBITDA.

1747777.name: Blue Owl Technology Finance Corp.
1747777.text: Blue Owl Technology Finance is a Maryland corporation that makes loans and equity investments in technology-related companies, with a focus on enterprise software. It invests in application software, systems and infrastructure software, and fintech and payments software. It focuses primarily on companies based in the United States.

1748797.name: BRP Inc.
1748797.text: BRP Inc. is a Quebec, Canada corporation with principal executive offices in Valcourt, Quebec. The excerpt is a Form 40-F cover page and does not describe its products, markets or customers.

1751008.text: AppLovin provides AI-powered advertising software, including Axon Ads Manager for user acquisition, MAX for app monetization, Adjust for measurement and attribution, and Wurl for connected TV. Its customers are advertisers, advertising networks, and mobile app and gaming publishers, and its tools target users worldwide.

1753539.text: BlackSky Technology is a space technology company headquartered in Herndon, Virginia, that delivers real-time satellite imagery, analytics and monitoring from its low earth orbit satellite constellation and its BlackSky Spectra software platform. It also helps customers acquire, own and operate their own satellites. Most of its sales are to domestic and international government agencies.

1754068.name: Kalaris Therapeutics, Inc.
1754068.text: Kalaris Therapeutics is a clinical stage biopharmaceutical company developing TH103, an anti-VEGF drug for retinal diseases, currently being investigated for neovascular age-related macular degeneration (nAMD). The company is conducting a Phase 1b/2 study of TH103. Its customers are not described in the excerpt.

1754301.name: Fox Corp
1754301.text: Fox is a news, sports and entertainment company with cable network programming, television (including the FOX broadcast network, the Tubi streaming service, and 29 broadcast stations), and Credible, a U.S. consumer finance marketplace. It also operates the FOX Studio Lot in Los Angeles, California, providing production services and office space. Its operations are primarily in the U.S., and it serves traditional and virtual MVPDs and other digital platforms.

1756655.text: Ardent Health (ARDT) is a holding company whose affiliates operate acute care hospitals, ambulatory facilities, telehealth services and physician practices. It operates in eight mid-sized urban markets across Texas, Oklahoma, New Mexico, New Jersey, Idaho and Kansas. It served approximately 1.2 million unique patients in 2025.

1756708.name: Jumia Technologies AG
1756708.text: Jumia Technologies operates a pan-African e-commerce platform comprising a marketplace that connects sellers with customers, a logistics service for shipping and delivering packages, and payment gateways. It operates in selected African markets and has announced an exit from Algeria.

1758009.text: Quantum Computing Inc. (QCi) develops photonics-based quantum computing machines and applications in machine learning, remote sensing, imaging and cybersecurity. It is based in Hoboken, New Jersey. Its February 2026 acquisition, Luminar Semiconductor (LSI), serves aerospace and defense, sensing and instrumentation, and optical communications customers.

1758021.text: Karat Packaging (Karat) distributes and manufactures disposable foodservice products, including containers, bags, cups, lids, cutlery, straws and gloves, in plastic, paper and compostable forms. It sources from nearly 150 vendors and has select manufacturing in the U.S. Its customers include national and regional distributors, restaurant and supermarket chains, retail shops and online customers.

1759614.name: Yunji Inc.
1759614.text: Yunji Inc. is a Cayman Islands holding company that conducts part of its business in China through a variable interest entity (VIE) and contractual arrangements with its PRC subsidiary, Yunchuang Sharing. The excerpt does not describe its products or customers.

1759631.name: Hyliion Holdings Corp.
1759631.text: Hyliion Holdings Corp. (Hyliion) is a Delaware corporation headquartered in Cedar Park, Texas, with research and development facilities in Cincinnati, Ohio. It designs and develops power generators, including its KARNO Power Module, and provides R&D services, initially targeting the datacenter, commercial, industrial, and defense sectors.

1760965.text: Kontoor is a global lifestyle apparel company whose brands include Wrangler, Lee and Helly Hansen. It designs, sells and licenses apparel, footwear and accessories through wholesale and direct-to-consumer channels in the U.S. and internationally, primarily in EMEA, APAC and Non-U.S. Americas.

1761612.text: BICYCLE THERAPEUTICS (BCYC) is a clinical-stage pharmaceutical company developing Bicycle molecules, synthetic peptides, mainly for oncology. Its lead candidates include nuzefatide pevedotin and BT1702. It also collaborates with biopharmaceutical companies in other therapeutic areas.

1769256.text: XChange TEC is an insurance agency business operating in China through variable interest entities, with substantially all of its operations and assets located in China. It works with customers, suppliers and business partners in its insurance agency business.

1769628.text: CoreWeave offers CoreWeave Cloud, an AI-focused cloud platform providing high-performance compute, managed cloud services, storage and orchestration software for AI model training, inference and related workloads. It operates data centers across North America and Europe. Its customers include AI labs, leading enterprises and technology companies deploying AI at scale.

1770787.name: 10x Genomics, Inc.
1770787.text: 10x Genomics is a life sciences technology company providing instruments, consumables, and software for analyzing biological systems at single-cell and spatial resolution. Its products serve researchers, including academic and translational researchers and biopharmaceutical companies, around the world. Its revenue was $642.8 million for 2025.

1771007.text: Afya provides educational services, including medical degree programs in its Undergraduate segment and courses in its Continuing Education segment. Its operations are subject to Brazilian regulation, and it serves students enrolled in its courses, some of whom receive FIES financing.

1772253.text: FLEX LNG (FLNG) is a Bermuda-incorporated owner and commercial operator of fifth-generation LNG carriers, operating them under long-term charters. It operates through subsidiaries in Bermuda, the United Kingdom, Norway, the Isle of Man and the Marshall Islands. Four customers accounted for more than 98.5% of its 2025 revenues.

1780312.name: AST SpaceMobile, Inc.
1780312.text: AST SpaceMobile (ASTS) is building a space-based cellular broadband network of low Earth orbit satellites designed to connect directly to standard smartphones. It also intends to offer applications for U.S. government use. It partners with over 50 mobile network operators (MNOs), which would offer the service to their end-user customers.

1782524.name: Morgan Stanley Direct Lending Fund
1782524.text: Morgan Stanley Direct Lending Fund is a non-diversified, externally managed business development company that lends to U.S. middle-market companies, primarily through directly originated senior secured term loans. Its borrowers are middle-market companies in which private equity sponsors hold a controlling equity stake, and its adviser is an indirect subsidiary of Morgan Stanley.

1784570.text: BETA Technologies (BETA) designs, manufactures and sells electric aircraft, electric propulsion systems, batteries, motors, flight control systems and charging equipment. It operates in North America, with its final assembly facility in South Burlington, Vermont. It serves cargo and logistics, military, medical and passenger end markets, with customers including UPS, Air New Zealand and United Therapeutics.

1786108.name: Trinity Capital Inc.
1786108.text: Trinity Capital is an internally managed business development company regulated under the Investment Company Act of 1940. It provides secured loans and equipment financings to growth-stage companies. It also co-manages joint ventures that invest in loans it originates.

1786909.text: Sibanye-Stillwater is a mining company that produces gold, platinum group metals (PGMs), nickel, zinc and copper. It has South African-based operations. Its final refining and a large portion of its PGM sales are concentrated with one entity in the United States.

1787306.text: Arcutis Biotherapeutics is a commercial-stage biopharmaceutical company developing and commercializing topical and systemic treatments for dermatological diseases. Its lead product, ZORYVE, is approved in the U.S. and Canada for conditions including plaque psoriasis, seborrheic dermatitis and atopic dermatitis.

1787400.name: Nkarta, Inc.
1787400.text: Nkarta is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company developing allogeneic, off-the-shelf engineered natural killer cell therapies. Its lead program, NKX019, is a CD19-targeting CAR NK candidate studied in autoimmune diseases including lupus nephritis and systemic sclerosis.

1788060.text: Voyager Technologies (VOYG) designs, develops and operates defense, intelligence and space systems, including communications, missile-defense-enabling technologies, propulsion and energetics, and space infrastructure. It operates through Defense & National Security, Space Solutions and Starlab Space Stations segments. Its customers include defense, national security, civil and commercial space customers, and NASA is a development grant provider for its Starlab space station.

1788348.name: Brookfield Infrastructure Corp
1788348.text: Brookfield Infrastructure Corp is an alternative investment vehicle that owns and operates infrastructure assets, principally regulated gas transmission systems in Brazil, regulated distribution operations in the U.K. and global intermodal logistics operations. Its operations are predominantly in the U.K. and Brazil. Its U.K. distribution customers are primarily large energy retailers serving residential and commercial users in England, Scotland and Wales.

1789029.text: Aeva (AEVA) develops FMCW 4D LiDAR-on-chip sensing technology that measures depth, reflectivity and velocity. Its solutions are expected to be built into automobiles, industrial equipment, consumer devices and security products.

1789832.name: Hess Midstream LP
1789832.text: Hess Midstream LP is a fee-based, growth-oriented limited partnership that owns and operates midstream assets, including gathering, processing, terminaling, storage and produced water services. Its assets are primarily in the Bakken and Three Forks shale plays in North Dakota's Williston Basin. It provides services to Chevron, its subsidiaries and third-party customers.

1791706.name: Li Auto Inc.
1791706.text: Li Auto is a Cayman Islands holding company that operates in China through its PRC subsidiaries and variable interest entities (VIEs) under contractual arrangements. The VIEs contributed less than 0.1% of total revenues in 2023, 2024 and 2025. The excerpt does not describe its products or customers.

1791863.name: Brookfield Renewable Corp
1791863.text: Brookfield Renewable Corp is a Canadian corporation incorporated in British Columbia that serves as an alternative investment vehicle for investors who prefer owning Brookfield Renewable Partners units through a corporate structure. Its operations are primarily located in Brazil, Colombia, the United States and Europe. The excerpt references renewable power sources such as hydropower and wind.

1792849.text: HighPeak Energy (HPK) is an independent crude oil and natural gas exploration and production company. Its acreage is in the Midland Basin of the Permian Basin in West Texas, mainly Howard and Borden Counties.

1794350.text: Yalla Group operates Yalla, a voice-centric group chat platform, and Yalla Ludo, a casual gaming app featuring online board games popular in MENA. It conducts its operations mainly through subsidiaries in the UAE and China. Its users are in the Middle East and North Africa (MENA) region.

1796073.name: Vizsla Silver Corp.
1796073.text: Vizsla Silver Corp. is filing this annual report on Form 40-F. Its principal executive offices are in Vancouver, British Columbia, Canada. The excerpt does not describe its products, operations, or customers.

1798562.name: TMC the metals Co Inc.
1798562.text: TMC the metals company is a deep seabed minerals developer focused on collecting, processing and refining polymetallic nodules in international waters of the Clarion Clipperton Zone in the Eastern Pacific Ocean. It is in the development stage and has not yet obtained a commercial recovery permit.

1799788.name: Greenwich LifeSciences, Inc.
1799788.text: Greenwich LifeSciences is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company developing GP2 immunotherapy, its product candidate. The excerpt describes clinical trials of GP2 in patients with HER2/neu 1-3+, node-negative breast cancer.

1800667.text: JFrog provides a unified software supply chain platform for governance, security and delivery of software applications and AI/ML models. The platform serves enterprise software organizations and development teams. The company's customer base includes the majority of the Fortune 500 using it as a system of record for software development.

1801368.text: MP Materials is the largest producer of rare earth materials in the Western Hemisphere, with mining and processing operations at Mountain Pass, California and magnet manufacturing at Independence Facility in Texas. The company produces rare earth oxides, metals, alloys and magnets, selling primarily to customers in Japan, South Korea and Asia, as well as to automotive companies including General Motors.

1802255.name: Guardian Pharmacy Services, Inc.
1802255.text: Guardian Pharmacy Services provides high-touch consultative pharmacy services, supported by proprietary data analytics systems and technology, to help local pharmacies serve their facilities and residents. It serves long-term care facilities (LTCFs), assisted living facilities (ALFs) and behavioral health facilities (BHFs).

1802665.text: Harmony Biosciences is a neuroscience company focused on rare neurological diseases. Its lead product, WAKIX (pitolisant), is FDA-approved for excessive daytime sleepiness and cataplexy in narcolepsy, and it is developing treatments for other rare neurological conditions. WAKIX is prescribed by healthcare providers for patients with narcolepsy.

1805077.text: Eos Energy (EOSE) designs, manufactures and sells zinc-based battery energy storage systems for utility-scale, microgrid and commercial and industrial applications. Its manufacturing facility is in Turtle Creek, Pennsylvania, and its primary geographic market is North America. Its Z3 battery customers include utilities, independent power producers, renewable developers and C&I customers.

1808110.name: DDC Enterprise Ltd
1808110.text: DDC is a Cayman Islands holding company that conducts its operations primarily in China. It sells ready-to-heat, ready-to-cook, ready-to-eat and plant-based meal products and provides advertising services, targeting predominantly Millennial and Generation Z customers. It also holds Bitcoin as its primary treasury reserve asset.

1810806.text: Unity is a platform for developing and monetizing games and interactive experiences across mobile, PC, console, and extended reality. Create Solutions provide development tools and engines; Grow Solutions enable user acquisition and monetization. The platform serves creators globally across gaming and non-gaming industries.

1811414.name: QuantumScape Corp
1811414.text: QuantumScape develops solid-state lithium-metal battery technology for electric vehicles and other applications. Its battery development pilot line is in San Jose, California, and it works with automotive OEMs, including Volkswagen and its battery cell company PowerCo. Its potential customers include automotive OEMs, end-users and licensees.

1814067.name: Lixiang Education Holding Co. Ltd.
1814067.text: Lixiang Education provides educational services through PRC subsidiaries and variable interest entities (VIEs). It operates Qingtian International School in Lishui City, Zhejiang Province, which provides high school education to students from families of overseas Chinese returnees.

1815846.name: MINISO Group Holding Ltd
1815846.text: MINISO operates MINISO retail stores in China and several overseas markets, and conducts business through subsidiaries in Hong Kong, Italy, Germany, Vietnam, Canada and other locations. Its products are also sold in Mexico, the Philippines and Saudi Arabia through Retail Partners and local distributors.

1816581.text: Ouster offers a sensing and perception platform for Physical AI, including digital lidar sensors, cameras, AI compute, perception software and AI models. Its target markets are industrial, smart infrastructure, robotics and automotive, including automotive parts suppliers and OEMs.

1817241.text: Artiva is a clinical-stage biotechnology company developing off-the-shelf natural killer (NK) cell therapies for autoimmune diseases and cancers. Its lead product candidate, AlloNK, is being evaluated in three ongoing clinical trials, with refractory rheumatoid arthritis as the lead indication.

1817713.name: Janux Therapeutics, Inc.
1817713.text: Janux is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company developing immunotherapies for cancer patients using its TRACTr, TRACIr and ARM platforms. Its first clinical candidate, JANX007, is in a Phase 1 trial for metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer.

1818643.name: Phoenix Energy One, LLC
1818643.text: Phoenix Energy One is an oil and gas company that drills operated working interests and acquires royalty and non-operated working interests to produce crude oil, natural gas and natural gas liquids. Its drilling is focused on the Williston Basin in North Dakota and Montana and the Powder River and Denver-Julesburg Basins in Wyoming. The excerpt does not name its customers.

1819848.text: JOBY develops piloted, all-electric eVTOL aircraft designed to transport a pilot and up to four passengers at 200 mph speeds with up to 100-mile range. JOBY plans to operate air taxi services in markets including the United States and Dubai, and pursue aircraft sales. It operates manufacturing facilities in California and Ohio.

1819994.text: Rocket Lab is an end-to-end space company offering Electron launch services, spacecraft design and components, spacecraft manufacturing and optical systems, and is developing the Neutron launch vehicle. It operates launch complexes in Mahia, New Zealand and Wallops Island, Virginia. Its customers include U.S. government agencies such as NASA, the NRO and DARPA, and commercial spacecraft operators.

1821769.text: Navitas Semiconductor (NVTS) designs gallium nitride and silicon carbide power semiconductors, including power ICs, SiC devices and digital isolators, and contracts manufacturing to partner suppliers. It focuses on AI data centers, energy and grid infrastructure, performance computing and industrial electrification. Operations span the U.S., Ireland, Germany, Italy, Belgium, China, Taiwan, Thailand, South Korea and the Philippines.

1822966.text: NuScale Power (SMR) is developing its NuScale Power Module small modular reactor technology and related services, including licensing support, testing, training and fuel supply. Its customers are a mix of governments, utilities, state-owned enterprises and technology and industrial companies. It has been working with RoPower Nuclear in Romania and prospective customer ENTRA1.

1823529.name: Enact Holdings, Inc.
1823529.text: Enact Holdings (ACT) is a private mortgage insurer serving the U.S. housing finance market, covering a portion of the unpaid principal on low down payment mortgage loans. It operates in all 50 states and the District of Columbia, and its customers are mortgage originators, including national banks, non-bank mortgage lenders, community banks and credit unions.

1823652.name: Eve Holding, Inc.
1823652.text: Eve Holding, Inc. (Eve) is an aerospace company developing electric vertical take-off and landing vehicles (eVTOLs), along with TechCare maintenance services and Vector, an urban air traffic management system. It has operations in Melbourne, Florida and São Paulo, Brazil, and plans to market to UAM service operators, fixed-wing and helicopter operators, lessors, air navigation service providers, and vertiport operators.

1823986.name: Waterdrop Inc.
1823986.text: Waterdrop reports its financials in Renminbi and is classified by the SEC under insurance agents, brokers and services. The excerpt does not describe its products, operating locations or customers.

1824502.text: Archer Aviation is developing the Midnight electric vertical take-off and landing (eVTOL) aircraft for air taxi operations, plus a dual-use VTOL aircraft with Anduril for defense and commercial use. It plans commercial operations in U.S. cities and the UAE, and is offering aircraft through a Launch Edition program to governments and customers.

1824920.text: IonQ is a quantum computing platform company developing quantum computers and related networking, sensing, and security products. It offers quantum-computing-as-a-service through AWS, Microsoft, and Google Cloud platforms, and provides professional services.

1828108.text: Aurora Innovation develops the Aurora Driver, a self-driving technology platform for autonomous vehicles. Founded in 2017, the company focuses initially on trucking, with plans to expand to passenger mobility and local goods delivery. Aurora partners with major vehicle manufacturers and logistics companies and operates in the United States.

1828318.text: Enovix is a battery company developing and manufacturing silicon-anode lithium-ion batteries for smartphones, smart eyewear, defense, industrial and edge-AI applications. Its manufacturing and R&D are conducted primarily in Malaysia, South Korea and India, with corporate functions at its U.S. headquarters. Its customers include mobile OEMs, smart eyewear customers, and defense and industrial customers.

1828365.name: RLX Technology Inc.
1828365.text: RLX Technology is a Cayman Islands holding company whose business operates both inside and outside China, conducted through subsidiaries including Shenzhen Wuxin and Beijing Yueke. The excerpt describes its corporate structure and history but does not describe its products or customers.

1828962.name: Cricut, Inc.
1828962.text: Cricut sells a creativity platform made up of connected cutting machines, accessories and materials, centered on its cloud-based app, Cricut Design Space. The company reports nearly 5.9 million Active Users as of December 31, 2025, who use its products to make DIY goods such as greeting cards, apparel and home decor. Its machines cut materials including paper, vinyl, wood and leather.

1829864.text: TaskUs provides outsourced digital customer experience, trust and safety, and AI services, including data annotation and LLM support. Its clients, about 200 as of December 31, 2025, include global companies in AI, autonomous vehicles, social media, financial services and healthcare. It operates 31 sites in 13 countries.

1831907.name: LuxExperience B.V.
1831907.text: LuxExperience Group is a multi-brand digital luxury group operating websites and apps that offer womenswear, menswear, kidswear, lifestyle products and fine jewelry from luxury brands. It serves global luxury consumers shopping worldwide, and its business began with a boutique in Munich, Germany.

1833214.name: SAB Biotherapeutics, Inc.
1833214.text: SAB Biotherapeutics, Inc. (SABS) is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company developing multi-specific human immunoglobulin G therapies for immune and autoimmune disorders, led by SAB-142 for autoimmune type 1 diabetes. Its antibodies are produced using transchromosomic cattle (Tc-Bovine). The excerpt does not describe where it operates or its customers.

1835724.name: Zhihu Inc.
1835724.text: Zhihu is a leading online content community in China where users find answers, make decisions, and engage with content. It earns revenue from online advertising, paid content, its paid membership program, content-commerce solutions, and vocational training, and serves both users and content creators.

1836470.name: Sportradar Group AG
1836470.text: Sportradar is a technology platform and B2B provider of data, software and content to the global sports betting industry, with principal offices in St. Gallen, Switzerland. Its products span data collection and processing, visualization, risk management and platform services. Customers include sports leagues and federations, betting operators and media companies.

1836754.text: Legacy Education owns accredited career colleges in California, offering healthcare and other career programs. The colleges are High Desert Medical College, Central Coast College, Integrity College of Health and Contra Costa Medical Career College. Its target students are early- to mid-20-year-olds, mainly living within a 100-mile radius of each campus.

1836981.name: BigBear.ai Holdings, Inc.
1836981.text: BigBear.ai Holdings, Inc. is a provider of artificial intelligence technology, including computer vision, predictive analytics and biometrics, and its Ask Sage generative AI platform. It was founded to serve defense and national security customers, primarily the U.S. government, and also works with select commercial partners. Its stated objective is serving the U.S., its allies and those partners.

1838359.text: RGTI develops superconducting quantum computers and provides cloud-based and on-premises quantum computing services. It serves commercial enterprises and government organizations including AWS, DOE, and DARPA, operating from facilities in the U.S., UK, and India.

1838406.text: BKV is an energy company focused on natural gas production, natural gas midstream, natural gas-fired power generation and carbon capture (CCUS). It operates in Texas, including the Barnett Shale, where its BKV Energy unit sells electricity to commercial, industrial and residential customers.

1838413.text: Full Truck Alliance is a Cayman Islands holding company whose operations are conducted primarily in China, through contractual arrangements with variable interest entities and through subsidiaries. Its ADSs are listed on the NYSE under the ticker 'YMM'.

1839285.name: Healthcare Triangle, Inc.
1839285.text: Healthcare Triangle is a healthcare information technology company providing cloud services, data science, and professional and managed services for the Electronic Health Record (EHR), healthcare and life sciences industry. Its customers include healthcare delivery organizations, healthcare insurance companies, pharmaceutical and life sciences companies, biotech companies, and medical device manufacturers.

1840706.name: SOPHiA GENETICS SA
1840706.text: SOPHiA GENETICS is a cloud-native healthcare software company whose SOPHiA DDM platform standardizes, computes and analyzes digital health data to generate AI-driven insights. Its customers include healthcare institutions and biopharmaceutical companies for precision medicine across oncology, rare diseases and other areas. Its principal executive office is in Rolle, Switzerland.

1840856.text: SoundHound offers independent Voice AI technology, including its Houndify developer platform, Smart Answering and Smart Ordering products, and an AI agent platform. Its customers are product creators in automotive, TV and IoT, and customer service businesses, including restaurants.

1842827.name: Kanzhun Ltd
1842827.text: Kanzhun is a leading online recruitment platform in China, operating the BOSS Zhipin app. It serves enterprises from small businesses to large corporations, including all 2025 Fortune China 500 companies, through business executives, HR officers and headhunters.

1843162.name: Chicago Atlantic BDC, Inc.
1843162.text: Chicago Atlantic BDC is an externally managed business development company that provides loans. Its growth and technology sub-strategy focuses on industry leaders and disruptive companies with strong growth trajectories, including private equity and venture capital backed businesses and non-sponsor backed companies.

1844862.text: Solid Power is a U.S.-based developer of solid-state battery technology, focused on a sulfide-based solid electrolyte it manufactures and sells. It sells electrolyte to Tier 1 battery manufacturers and automotive OEMs that produce their own cells. It collaborates with BMW, Samsung SDI and SK On.

1845840.text: Telesat is a global satellite operator providing satellite communications services for voice, data and broadcast in the Americas, including Canada's far North, and is building the Telesat Lightspeed LEO satellite network for enterprise and government customers. It also operates Telesat Government Solutions, a U.S. government-approved subsidiary.

1846832.name: dLocal Ltd
1846832.text: dLocal provides online payment solutions, including pay-in, pay-out and local-to-local transactions, for global enterprise merchants in emerging markets. It operates in 44 countries, including Brazil, Mexico, Argentina, Colombia, Chile, Nigeria, South Africa, Morocco, India, the Philippines and Indonesia. Its customers are global enterprise merchants in high-growth, technology-related verticals.

1849056.name: Oklo Inc.
1849056.text: Oklo develops Aurora powerhouses, fast fission reactors that produce electricity and heat and can run on fresh, recycled or down-blended nuclear fuel, and is commercializing nuclear fuel recycling technology. It has a site use permit from the U.S. Department of Energy for the Idaho National Laboratory site. Its non-binding and binding customer arrangements include Meta Platforms, Switch and Equinix.

1849253.name: RYAN SPECIALTY HOLDINGS, INC.
1849253.text: Ryan Specialty is an international specialty insurance intermediary offering wholesale insurance brokerage and delegated underwriting authority across property, casualty, professional lines, transportation, personal lines, workers' compensation and employee benefits. It serves retail insurance brokers and insurance carriers, including Lloyd's syndicates, multi-line underwriters and E&S specialists.

1849635.text: TMTG operates Truth Social, a social media platform, and Truth+, a TV streaming platform with live TV channels and on-demand content. It also operates Truth.Fi, a financial services and FinTech brand that includes a digital asset strategy with a bitcoin treasury.
