820318.text: Coherent (Coherent Corp.) develops, manufactures and markets lasers, transceivers, optical and optoelectronic devices, modules, systems and engineered materials for datacenter, communications and industrial markets. It is headquartered in Saxonburg, Pennsylvania, with production and R&D operations in the U.S., China, Finland, Germany, Malaysia, Singapore, South Korea, Sweden, Switzerland, the UK and other countries. Customers include optical component makers, networking equipment manufacturers, datacenter operators and telecom service providers, plus semiconductor and display capital equipment makers.

821002.text: G-III designs, sources, distributes and markets apparel and accessories under owned brands such as DKNY, Donna Karan, Karl Lagerfeld and Vilebrequin, and licensed brands such as Calvin Klein and Tommy Hilfiger. It sells at wholesale, through its own digital platforms and retail stores, and to retailers including Macy's, Costco, Kohl's and Ross Stores for private-label collections.

821130.name: ARRAY DIGITAL INFRASTRUCTURE, INC.
821130.text: Array is a tower owner and operator that leases tower space to tenants and provides ancillary services. It owned 4,450 towers in 19 states as of December 31, 2025. Its largest tenants include T-Mobile, AT&T and Verizon, and it also serves non-carrier customers.

822663.text: Interparfums manufactures, markets and distributes prestige fragrances under brands such as Boucheron, Coach, Jimmy Choo, GUESS and Hollister, using third-party fillers rather than owned plants. Its European operations, based in Paris, distribute products in over 120 countries. Macy's is its top retail customer.

827054.text: Microchip develops, manufactures and sells embedded control semiconductor solutions for a wide variety of applications, selling primarily to distributors and direct customers worldwide.

829224.text: Starbucks roasts and retails specialty coffee, handcrafted beverages and food through company-operated and licensed stores, and sells coffee and tea through grocery and foodservice channels. It operates in 89 markets. It serves consumers in its stores and through these grocery and foodservice channels.

831641.text: Tetra Tech is a global consulting and engineering services company specializing in water, environment and sustainable infrastructure solutions. The company operates through two segments serving U.S. government clients (federal, state and local), international development agencies and commercial clients across more than 100 countries.

833079.name: Meritage Homes CORP
833079.text: Meritage designs and builds single-family attached and detached homes, mainly entry-level and first move-up homes. It operates in twelve U.S. states, including Arizona, California, Texas and Florida. Its financial services offer title, mortgage and insurance services to homebuyers.

834365.name: BIOLIFE SOLUTIONS INC
834365.text: BioLife Solutions is a life sciences company that develops, manufactures and markets bioproduction products and services. Its biopreservation media and cell processing products help preserve biologic material during sourcing, manufacturing and distribution. Its customers are companies in the cell and gene therapy industry.

835403.text: Diageo is a spirits company with a portfolio of brands, including ready-to-drink (RTD) cocktails, Smirnoff Ice and Guinness. It operates in five regions, with North America as its largest market. It sells to wholesalers and distributors, which also sell other brands.

836690.text: IA designs, manufactures and services avionics products and flight solutions for commercial air transport, business aviation and military aircraft, including flight deck displays, navigation and sensor systems. It operates a facility in Exton, Pennsylvania, and its customers include the U.S. government, Boeing, Lockheed Martin and Pilatus.

844551.text: Woodside (WDS) is an Australian energy company listed on the ASX and NYSE that produces and holds reserves of crude oil and natural gas. Its proved reserves and production are in fields in Australia, Senegal and the United States Gulf of America.

84839.text: Rollins is a global pest and wildlife control services company with over 800 locations in approximately 70 countries. It serves more than two million residential and commercial customers through brands including Orkin and Clark Pest Control.

851205.text: Deckers Outdoor designs, markets, and distributes footwear, apparel, and accessories under three core brands: HOKA, UGG, and Teva. The company operates globally through wholesale distribution to retailers and independent distributors, and direct-to-consumer channels including e-commerce and 203 company-owned retail stores as of March 2026.

851520.text: Exponent is a science and engineering consulting firm that solves complex technical problems across more than 90 disciplines, including engineering, data sciences and health sciences. It serves clients around the world in sectors such as chemical, consumer products, energy, government, life sciences, insurance, manufacturing and technology, often engaged by corporations, law firms or insurers.

85535.name: ROYAL GOLD INC
85535.text: Royal Gold acquires and manages precious metal streams and royalty interests, and finances mining projects in exchange for those interests. It does not conduct mining operations on the properties. The excerpt cites properties in the United States, Canada, Chile, the Dominican Republic, Zambia, and Ecuador.

855658.text: Lattice Semiconductor develops low-power programmable logic devices and FPGAs for edge-to-cloud applications as a fabless provider. The company serves global markets in communications and computing, industrial and automotive, and consumer sectors, with customers building data centers, 5G infrastructure, IoT devices, and automotive systems.

858446.name: INTERCONTINENTAL HOTELS GROUP PLC /NEW/
858446.text: IHG is a hotel company operating a portfolio of hotel brands, including Holiday Inn, Hotel Indigo, and Regent, and the Ruby urban lifestyle brand acquired in 2025. It has hotels in the Americas, EMEAA, and Greater China, and offers a loyalty program and mobile app. Its hotels are operated by owners and franchise partners.

858877.name: CISCO SYSTEMS, INC.
858877.text: Cisco designs and sells networking, security, collaboration and observability technologies, including hardware, software, AI-powered digital infrastructure and related services. It manages its business across the Americas, EMEA, and APJC. Its customers include businesses of all sizes, public institutions, governments, service providers and hyperscalers.

863064.text: Rio Tinto is a metals and mining company domiciled in the UK and Australia. The report focuses on iron ore, copper, aluminium and lithium, and includes the Simandou project in Guinea.

865752.text: Monster Beverage develops, markets and distributes energy drinks, craft beers, flavored malt beverages and hard seltzers through four operating segments. Based in Corona, California, the company sells primarily to bottlers, distributors, and retail chains in the U.S. and internationally.

866291.text: Allegro Microsystems designs and manufactures sensor integrated circuits and power management ICs for automotive, industrial, and data center applications. Its magnetic sensor and power IC portfolio enables motion control, sensing, and power management. The company serves global automotive OEMs and suppliers, data center operators, and industrial robotics manufacturers.

866787.text: AutoZone is a leading retailer of automotive replacement parts and accessories across the Americas. As of August 2025, it operated 6,627 stores in the US, 883 in Mexico, and 147 in Brazil. It serves retail customers and provides commercial parts delivery and credit to repair garages, dealers, service stations, and fleet owners.

866829.text: HOS is listed on the NYSE, but the excerpt describes Helix Energy Solutions Group (ticker HLX). It provides offshore energy services, including well intervention, robotics and decommissioning, mainly in the Gulf of America, Brazil, the North Sea, West Africa and Asia Pacific. Its customers include oil and gas producers, pipeline companies and renewable energy companies.

8670.text: ADP is a global leader in Human Capital Management solutions serving over 1.1 million clients across 140+ countries. The company provides payroll processing, benefits administration, talent management, HR outsourcing and workforce management solutions. ADP serves businesses ranging from small enterprises to Fortune 500 companies.

872589.text: Regeneron is a fully integrated biotechnology company that invents, develops, manufactures and commercializes medicines for patients with serious diseases including eye conditions, cancer, and inflammatory disorders. The company works with collaborators and licensees on product development and commercialization.

874716.text: IDEXX develops, manufactures and distributes diagnostic products and provides laboratory services for companion animal and livestock veterinarians, biomedical researchers, and water testing customers across North America, Europe, and Asia-Pacific.

874866.text: CorVel is a nationwide provider of medical cost containment and managed care services for workers' compensation, auto insurance and group health claims. Its services include claims management, bill review, PPO networks, utilization and case management, and pharmacy services. It serves insurance companies, third-party administrators, government entities and self-administered employers.

875320.text: VRTX is a global biotechnology company with marketed medicines for cystic fibrosis, sickle cell disease, and beta thalassemia. It sells medicines through specialty distributors and pharmacies globally.

879169.text: Incyte is a global biopharmaceutical company developing therapies in hematology, oncology, and inflammation. Approved products include JAKAFI for myelofibrosis and graft-versus-host disease, ICLUSIG for chronic myeloid leukemia, and MONJUVI for lymphoma. The company operates globally with headquarters in the United States, Switzerland, Japan, and Canada.

879585.text: ATN provides fixed and mobile telecommunications, broadband, and carrier communications services, including fiber transport, in rural and remote markets. It operates primarily in the western US and Alaska, and internationally in Bermuda and the Caribbean. Customers include residential, business and government customers, and carrier customers.

880117.name: SANFILIPPO JOHN B & SON INC
880117.text: John B. Sanfilippo & Son processes and distributes tree nuts and peanuts, and manufactures snack and nutrition bars, nut butters and other snack products, largely under private brand names. It operates in the United States, with headquarters in Elgin, Illinois. Its customers include food retailers, commercial ingredient users and contract manufacturing customers.

88121.text: Seaboard is a diversified company in pork production and processing, biofuel, commodity trading and grain processing, cargo shipping and power generation. It operates in the U.S., Africa, South America, the Caribbean and the Dominican Republic. Pork is sold to processors, foodservice operators, distributors and grocery stores; power goes to government-owned distribution companies in the Dominican Republic.

88205.text: SPX Technologies offers HVAC solutions including cooling, heating, and ventilation products, as well as detection and measurement equipment for infrastructure inspection and maintenance. The company serves industrial, institutional, and commercial customers, including utilities, telecommunications providers, and government agencies.

882184.text: D.R. Horton is the largest homebuilder in the United States, constructing and selling homes across 126 markets in 36 states. The company also provides mortgage financing and title services to homebuyers.

883241.text: Synopsys provides electronic design automation software and hardware used to design and test integrated circuits, plus silicon IP, simulation and analysis software (including Ansys) and design services. Its customers include chip and system engineers and software developers, and Ansys products are used across industries such as high-tech, aerospace and defense, and automotive.

884269.text: Alpha Pro Tech makes disposable protective apparel and infection control products, and construction weatherization products such as housewrap and roof underlayment. Its executive offices are in Aurora, Ontario, and its products are distributed principally in the United States. Its customers include construction supply and roofing distributors, pharmaceutical, medical device and semiconductor manufacturers, and medical and dental distributors.

885245.text: Buckle is a retailer of medium to better-priced casual apparel, footwear, and accessories. As of January 31, 2026, it operated 440 stores in 42 U.S. states under the Buckle and Buckle Youth names. It serves fashion-conscious men, women, and kids.

885639.name: KOHLS Corp
885639.text: Kohl's operates 1,153 stores and a website selling moderately priced proprietary and national brand apparel, footwear, accessories, beauty and home products. Its nine retail distribution centers are located throughout the United States.

886128.text: FuelCell is a clean energy technology company that manufactures and sells molten carbonate fuel cell systems for baseload power, carbon capture and thermal energy. It markets its products primarily in the U.S., Canada, the EU, the UK, South Korea, Singapore, Malaysia and Thailand. Customers include utilities, independent power producers and data centers.

887733.name: CENTRAL GARDEN & PET CO
887733.text: Central is a market leader in the U.S. pet and garden industries, with Pet and Garden reportable segments. Its Pet products include dog and cat supplies, aquatics and small animal supplies, and its Garden products include grass seed, wild bird feed, herbicides and fertilizers. It sells to retail partners, including eCommerce channels, and to consumers.

887936.name: FTI CONSULTING, INC
887936.text: FTI Consulting is a global expert firm providing advisory services for organizations facing crisis and transformation, through segments including Corporate Finance, Forensic and Litigation Consulting, Economic Consulting, Technology, and Strategic Communications. It has offices across the Americas, Latin America, Asia Pacific, and Europe, the Middle East and Africa. Its clients include Fortune 500 corporations, major law firms, private equity firms, global banks, and governments.

888746.text: CCU (Compañía Cervecerías Unidas) produces and sells beer, soft drinks, mineral water, wine, pisco and rum. It operates in Chile and Argentina and sells in Bolivia, Colombia, Paraguay and Uruguay. It sells to retail, supermarket and wholesale customers.

889132.name: POSCO HOLDINGS INC.
889132.text: POSCO Holdings is a holding company whose subsidiary POSCO is one of the largest steel producers in the world. POSCO manufactures cold rolled and hot rolled products, stainless steel, plates, wire rods and silicon steel sheets, with major production in Korea at its Pohang and Gwangyang works. Its customers include manufacturers in the automotive, shipbuilding, home appliance, engineering and machinery industries.

88941.text: SMTC designs and manufactures high-performance semiconductors for data center networking, IoT connectivity, and cellular infrastructure. Its products serve original equipment manufacturers, IoT device makers, and enterprises across infrastructure, consumer and industrial markets globally.

889971.text: LightPath makes infrared and precision optical components, assemblies and infrared camera systems, serving defense, public safety, industrial, commercial, telecom and medical customers. It has facilities in the United States and Latvia, with headquarters in Orlando, Florida.

894627.text: VAALCO Energy is an independent oil, natural gas and NGL company engaged in acquisition, exploration, development and production. Its assets are located in Gabon, Egypt, Cote d'Ivoire, Equatorial Guinea and Nigeria, and it has agreed to sell its Canadian operations. The excerpt does not describe its customers.

895447.text: Shoe Carnival is an omnichannel footwear retailer for the family, selling national brands such as Nike, Skechers and adidas. It operates 426 stores under the Shoe Carnival and Shoe Station banners across 35 states and Puerto Rico, plus online shopping. Shoe Carnival stores mainly serve moderate to low-income families, while Shoe Station targets a more affluent footwear customer.

896264.text: USANA Health Sciences (USNA) develops and manufactures nutritional supplements, functional foods and personal care products. Its core business sells through direct selling, and its Hiya segment sells children's health products direct-to-consumer, with a subscription model. It operates in 25 geographic markets worldwide, with China as its largest market. Its customers are Brand Partners and Preferred Customers in the core business, and Hiya subscribers in the U.S.

896878.text: Intuit is a global financial technology platform serving approximately 93 million consumers, small and mid-market businesses, and accountants. The company provides tax, accounting, financial management and marketing solutions through products including TurboTax, QuickBooks, Credit Karma and Mailchimp.

898173.text: O'Reilly Automotive is a specialty retailer of automotive aftermarket parts, tools, supplies and equipment. It operates 6,447 stores in the United States and Puerto Rico, plus locations in Mexico and Canada. The company serves both do-it-yourself customers and professional service providers.

903129.name: Gentherm Inc
903129.text: Gentherm is a global provider of thermal management and pneumatic comfort technologies, including automotive products such as Climate Control Seats and medical patient temperature management systems. It operates in locations aligned with its major customers' product strategies, and its medical systems are found in hospitals throughout the world.

904851.name: YPF SOCIEDAD ANONIMA
904851.text: YPF is Argentina's leading integrated energy company, with upstream, midstream, downstream, LNG, and new energies segments. It operates mainly in Argentina, and its Trading unit sells refined products and crude oil to international and domestic customers. It markets refined petroleum and petrochemical products throughout Argentina through distributors and a retail network.

906163.name: NVR INC
906163.text: NVR Inc. (NVR) is a homebuilder that constructs and sells single-family detached homes, townhomes and condominium buildings, primarily on a pre-sold basis, and also operates a mortgage banking and title services business. It operates in thirty-seven metropolitan areas in sixteen states and Washington, D.C. Its customers are homebuyers, including first-time and move-up buyers.

907242.name: MONARCH CASINO & RESORT INC
907242.text: Monarch Casino & Resort owns and operates the Atlantis Casino Resort Spa in Reno, Nevada, and the Monarch Casino Resort Spa Black Hawk in Black Hawk, Colorado. Its hotel and casino offerings include gaming, food and beverage, and hotel operations. It targets leisure travelers, conventioneers and Northern Nevada residents.

908255.name: BORGWARNER INC
908255.text: BorgWarner makes clean and efficient technology products for combustion, hybrid and electric vehicles, including turbochargers, thermal systems and battery charging systems. It operates manufacturing facilities serving customers in Europe, the Americas and Asia. Its customers are mainly vehicle original equipment manufacturers, plus tier one suppliers and aftermarket distributors.

908315.text: Winmark (WINA) is a franchisor of five resale retail brands: Plato's Closet, Once Upon A Child, Play It Again Sports, Style Encore and Music Go Round. Its franchisees sell gently used and some new merchandise, with 1,378 franchised stores in the United States and Canada. The stores serve consumers who buy and sell used goods.

90896.name: Champion Homes, Inc.
90896.text: Champion Homes produces factory-built housing in North America, including manufactured and modular homes, park model RVs, accessory dwelling units and modular buildings. Its manufacturing facilities are located across the United States and in western Canada. It markets homes through independent and company-owned retail sales centers, community operators, government agencies, and builder/developers.

909037.name: CHEMICAL & MINING CO OF CHILE INC
909037.text: SQM produces nitrates, iodine, potassium chloride, lithium, and specialty plant nutrients from ore and brine deposits in northern Chile, including the Salar de Atacama. It is the largest producer of potassium nitrate, and it also sells fertilizers and blends, including products it does not produce.

9092.text: Badger Meter is a global provider of water management solutions, including flow meters, water quality and leak detection sensors, communication endpoints and cloud software. Utility Water products are sold to water utilities, and Flow Instrumentation products to commercial and industrial customers. Its largest geographic market is North America, primarily the United States.

909832.text: Costco operates membership warehouses and e-commerce sites selling nationally-branded and private-label foods, non-foods, fresh foods and gasoline, plus pharmacy and optical services. It operates in the U.S., Puerto Rico, Canada, Mexico, Japan, the U.K., Korea, Australia, Taiwan, China, Spain, France and Sweden, among other countries. It serves paying members, who pay an annual fee.

910329.text: Medifast is a health and wellness company offering a coach-guided lifestyle system with science-based weight loss plans and products. Its independent coaches support clients and market its products, primarily through word-of-mouth and social media. Products are shipped directly to clients.

910521.text: Deck designs, markets and distributes footwear, apparel and accessories under the HOKA, UGG and Teva brands for casual lifestyle and high-performance use. It operates globally through wholesale retailers and distributors, as well as direct-to-consumer e-commerce and retail stores.

91142.text: A. O. Smith manufactures and markets residential and commercial water heaters, boilers, heat pumps, tanks and water treatment products through two segments: North America (78% of sales) and Rest of World. The company serves residential and commercial markets through wholesale distribution, retail channels and direct-to-consumer sales.

912093.name: VIAVI SOLUTIONS INC.
912093.text: Viavi Solutions is a global leader in test and measurement and optical technologies, providing test, monitoring, and resilient Position, Navigation and Timing solutions. Its products also include optical security pigments and 3D sensing technologies. Its customers include telecommunications service providers, network equipment makers, semiconductor vendors, cloud operators, and military and aerospace organizations, such as AT&T, Cisco Systems, Ericsson, and Verizon.

912615.text: Urbn operates global lifestyle brands including Anthropologie, Free People, Urban Outfitters and Nuuly, offering fashion apparel, accessories, home goods and apparel subscription services. It sells through Company-owned stores in North America and Europe, franchisee stores in the Middle East, and digital channels.

912767.text: UFP Industries manufactures wood and composite products through three business segments: Retail Solutions, Packaging, and Construction. Operating across the United States, Mexico, Canada, Spain, India and Australia, it serves retailers, distributors, building materials companies, and industrial customers.

912892.name: GRUPO TELEVISA, S.A.B.
912892.text: Grupo Televisa is a telecommunications company that owns and operates a major cable network group and a leading direct-to-home satellite pay television system in Mexico. Its cable networks offer high-speed data, video, mobile and voice services to residential and commercial customers, plus managed services to domestic and international enterprises.

913760.name: StoneX Group Inc.
913760.text: StoneX Group (SNEX) operates a global financial services network offering market access, trade execution, clearing, custody and settlement through digital platforms and high-touch service. It serves more than 80,000 commercial, institutional and payments clients and over 400,000 self-directed and retail accounts located in more than 180 countries.

914475.text: Neurocrine Biosciences is a biopharmaceutical company developing treatments for neurological, psychiatric, and endocrine disorders. It markets FDA-approved products INGREZZA and CRENESSITY for tardive dyskinesia, Huntington's disease, and congenital adrenal hyperplasia, primarily in the U.S.

916365.text: Tractor Supply is the largest rural lifestyle retailer in the U.S., operating 2,602 stores in 49 states and online. It sells farm, ranch, pet, and garden products to recreational farmers, ranchers, homesteaders, and rural consumers.

91767.text: SON designs and manufactures engineered and sustainable packaging across 265 locations in 37 countries. The company serves global brands in food, beverage, household, personal care, and pharmaceutical industries.

917851.name: Vale S.A.
917851.text: Vale is a metal mining company that produces iron ore fines, iron ore pellets, and nickel. Its operations referenced in the excerpt include mines, railways, and facilities in Brazil, including the states of Pará, Maranhão, Minas Gerais, and Espírito Santo.

920371.text: Simpson Manufacturing designs and manufactures structural solutions for wood and concrete construction, including connectors, fasteners, and lateral-force resisting systems. It serves residential and commercial construction markets across North America and Europe, as well as OEMs, component manufacturers, and national retailers.

920760.text: LEN is one of the largest U.S. homebuilders and also originates residential mortgage loans and provides title insurance. The company operates in over 20 states, primarily selling single-family and multifamily homes to first-time, move-up, active adult and luxury homebuyers.

92103.name: SOUTHERN CALIFORNIA EDISON Co
92103.text: Southern California Edison Company is the depositor and sponsor of SCE Recovery Funding LLC, the issuing entity named in this Form 10-K. The excerpt is a cover page and does not describe the company's operations, locations or customers.

922621.text: Erie Indemnity acts as attorney-in-fact for the Erie Insurance Exchange, providing policy issuance, claims handling and investment management services. The Exchange writes property and casualty insurance including auto, homeowners, commercial multi-peril and workers compensation through independent agencies.

924613.text: Nokia provides network equipment through two segments, Network Infrastructure, which includes optical, IP and fixed networks, and Mobile Infrastructure, which covers mobile networks. Its customers include telecommunication providers, mission critical enterprise customers and AI & Cloud customers.

924719.text: Smith-Midland manufactures and sells precast concrete products, including SlenderWall, Sierra Wall and Easi-Set utility vaults, and rents highway barriers. Its precast and barrier rental customers are mainly general contractors and federal, state and local transportation authorities in the Mid-Atlantic, Northeastern, Midwestern and Southeastern U.S. Its licensing subsidiary also licenses its products nationwide and internationally.

924822.name: MILLER INDUSTRIES INC /TN/
924822.text: Miller Industries designs and manufactures towing and recovery equipment, including car carriers and wreckers, and is headquartered in Ooltewah, Tennessee, with manufacturing in the U.S., France, the United Kingdom, and Italy. Its products are sold mainly through distributors serving all 50 states, Canada, Mexico, and other foreign markets, and through prime contractors to government entities.

927653.text: McKesson is a healthcare services company distributing pharmaceutical drugs and medical-surgical supplies. It operates four segments: North American Pharmaceutical (drug distribution in U.S. and Canada), Oncology & Multispecialty, Prescription Technology Solutions, and Medical-Surgical Solutions. The company serves pharmacies, hospitals, healthcare providers, and biopharma companies.

928876.text: Tower is a specialty foundry manufacturing processed wafers based on customers' design specifications. It operates facilities in Israel, the U.S., Japan, and Italy, serving semiconductor companies and fabless companies in markets including data centers, automotive, industrial, and medical devices.

929869.text: RELX is a global provider of information-based analytics and decision tools, now provided almost exclusively in electronic format, across four segments: Risk, Scientific, Technical & Medical, Legal and Exhibitions. It serves professional and business customers in more than 180 countries and territories, with offices in about 40 countries.

930157.text: Rentokil (RTO) is a UK public limited company providing pest control and hygiene services, including termite and pest management through its U.S. Terminix business. As of 31 December 2025 it operated 2,081 facilities in 90 countries. Its services protect people from pest-borne disease and the reputations of customers' brands.

930420.name: KFORCE INC
930420.text: Kforce is a solutions firm providing technology, finance and accounting, and other professional staffing services on temporary (Flex) and permanent (Direct Hire) bases. It serves clients across virtually all major industries, including Fortune 500 and other leading companies, and has a development center in Pune, India.

9326.name: BALCHEM CORP
9326.text: Balchem develops and manufactures specialty performance ingredients for nutritional, food, pharmaceutical, animal health, plant nutrition, sterilization, fumigation, and industrial markets. Its products include choline nutrients, mineral amino acid chelates, and encapsulated animal nutrition products. Customers include food and beverage manufacturers and animal health and nutrition businesses.

932695.name: CHINA YUCHAI INTERNATIONAL LTD
932695.text: China Yuchai is a Bermuda holding company that owns 76.4% of Yuchai through six wholly-owned subsidiaries. Its principal operating office is in Singapore, and Yuchai's principal manufacturing facilities are in Yulin city, China.

932787.text: STMicroelectronics (STM) is a global semiconductor company that designs and manufactures power, analog, sensor, MEMS and microcontroller products. It serves automotive, industrial, personal electronics, and communications equipment, computers and peripherals customers. Its head offices are in Schiphol, the Netherlands, and its operational headquarters are in Geneva, Switzerland.

93389.text: Standard Motor Products makes and distributes premium replacement parts for the automotive aftermarket, including engine management, electrical and safety, and temperature control parts, and provides custom-engineered solutions for vehicle and equipment manufacturers. It sells mainly to retailers, warehouse distributors and original equipment manufacturers in the United States, Europe, Canada, Mexico and other foreign countries.

935703.text: Dollar Tree operates approximately 9,000 discount retail stores across 48 U.S. states and the District of Columbia, plus 275 stores in Canada. The company carries approximately 8,400 items including consumables and discretionary merchandise, serving consumers through stores and online platforms.

936468.text: Lockheed Martin is an aerospace and defense company operating four segments: Aeronautics (military aircraft), Missiles and Fire Control, Rotary and Mission Systems (helicopters and defense systems), and Space. The company designs and manufactures advanced military aircraft, missiles, defense systems and related technologies. Its principal customers are U.S. Government agencies and international allies.

937098.text: TriNet provides HR solutions for small and medium-sized businesses (SMBs), including PEO and ASO services, employee benefits, payroll and payroll tax administration, and compliance consulting. Its targeted industry verticals include technology, financial services, life sciences, nonprofit, professional services and main street businesses.

937966.text: ASML makes lithography systems, with holistic lithography as its core business, and shipped an i-line system for advanced packaging in 2025. Its main campus is in the Veldhoven area of the Netherlands, and it also has an office in Korea and a technical training academy in Phoenix.

939767.name: EXELIXIS, INC.
939767.text: Exelixis (EXEL) is an oncology company that markets cancer medicines, led by its flagship molecule cabozantinib sold as CABOMETYX and COMETRIQ. Its products are approved in the U.S., the European Economic Area, the U.K., Japan and 68 other countries. Its customers include physicians treating cancer patients.

940944.name: DARDEN RESTAURANTS INC
940944.text: Darden Restaurants is a full-service restaurant company operating brands including Olive Garden, LongHorn Steakhouse, Ruth's Chris, and Yard House. As of May 31, 2026, it owned and operated 2,202 restaurants in the United States. Its brands operate principally in the U.S., and it does not rely on any major customers for sales.

941221.name: ICL Group Ltd.
941221.text: ICL Group (ICL) is an Israeli company headquartered in Tel Aviv that produces products including bromine solutions, phosphate rock, fertilizer-grade phosphoric acid and food specialty ingredients. It serves customers and distributors across food, beverage, confectionery and bakery end-markets worldwide, and has a presence in China.

943819.text: ResMed is a global leader in digital health and cloud-connected medical devices for sleep and breathing health. Products include CPAP systems for sleep apnea, ventilation devices, masks, diagnostics, and cloud-based health applications software. It operates in more than 140 countries serving patients, clinicians, and healthcare providers.

945983.text: Climb Global Solutions is a value-added IT distributor. Its Distribution segment (Climb Channel Solutions) sells software and technology products to corporate resellers, value added resellers, consultants and systems integrators worldwide. Its Solutions segment (Grey Matter) sells IT products and services directly to end users. The company operates distribution facilities in Millersville, Maryland and Dublin, Ireland.

946581.name: TAKE TWO INTERACTIVE SOFTWARE INC
946581.text: Take-Two Interactive is a developer, publisher, and marketer of interactive entertainment, operating principally through Rockstar Games, 2K, and Zynga. Its products are designed for console, mobile (smartphones and tablets), and PC, and are delivered through physical retail, digital download, online platforms, and cloud streaming. It serves consumers around the globe.

94845.text: Levi Strauss is one of the world's largest apparel companies, designing and marketing jeans, casual and dress pants, activewear, tops and jackets under Levi's, Levi Strauss Signature and Beyond Yoga brands. The company sells to approximately 120 countries through direct-to-consumer channels, wholesale customers and licensees.

949870.name: BOSTON BEER CO INC
949870.text: Boston Beer sells alcohol beverages, including beer, hard seltzer, flavored malt beverages, hard cider, and spirits-based ready-to-drink drinks, under brands such as Twisted Tea and Angry Orchard. It sells in the US and selected international markets, mainly to off-premise retailers like grocery and liquor stores and to on-premise venues like bars and restaurants.

97210.name: TERADYNE, INC
97210.text: Teradyne provides automated test equipment for semiconductors, wireless products, data storage and other electronics, along with collaborative robotic arms and autonomous mobile robots. Its robotics customers include manufacturing, logistics and industrial companies, and its test sales are concentrated among a limited number of major customers.

97476.text: Texas Instruments designs and manufactures semiconductors for electronics designers and manufacturers worldwide. Its products include analog and embedded processing semiconductors used in industrial, automotive, data center and communications applications. TI serves over 100,000 customers.

97745.name: THERMO FISHER SCIENTIFIC INC.
97745.text: Thermo Fisher provides reagents, instruments, consumables, analytical instruments, diagnostic products and pharmaceutical services. Its customers include pharmaceutical and biotech companies, hospitals and clinical diagnostic labs, universities, research institutions and government agencies.
